     834  static int request_handler_machine(
     835                  struct MHD_Connection *connection,
     836                  void *connection_cls) {
     837  
     838          _cleanup_(MHD_destroy_responsep) struct MHD_Response *response = NULL;
     839          RequestMeta *m = ASSERT_PTR(connection_cls);
     840          int r;
     841          _cleanup_free_ char *hostname = NULL, *pretty_name = NULL, *os_name = NULL;
     842          uint64_t cutoff_from = 0, cutoff_to = 0, usage = 0;
     843          sd_id128_t mid, bid;
     844          _cleanup_free_ char *v = NULL, *json = NULL;
     845  
     846          assert(connection);
     847  
     848          r = open_journal(m);
     849          if (r < 0)
     850                  return mhd_respondf(connection, r, MHD_HTTP_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Failed to open journal: %m");
     851  
     852          r = sd_id128_get_machine(&mid);
     853          if (r < 0)
     854                  return mhd_respondf(connection, r, MHD_HTTP_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Failed to determine machine ID: %m");
     855  
     856          r = sd_id128_get_boot(&bid);
     857          if (r < 0)
     858                  return mhd_respondf(connection, r, MHD_HTTP_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Failed to determine boot ID: %m");
     859  
     860          hostname = gethostname_malloc();
     861          if (!hostname)
     862                  return respond_oom(connection);
     863  
     864          r = sd_journal_get_usage(m->journal, &usage);
     865          if (r < 0)
     866                  return mhd_respondf(connection, r, MHD_HTTP_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Failed to determine disk usage: %m");
     867  
     868          r = sd_journal_get_cutoff_realtime_usec(m->journal, &cutoff_from, &cutoff_to);
     869          if (r < 0)
     870                  return mhd_respondf(connection, r, MHD_HTTP_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Failed to determine disk usage: %m");
     871  
     872          (void) parse_os_release(
     873                          NULL,
     874                          "PRETTY_NAME", &pretty_name,
     875                          "NAME=", &os_name);
     876          (void) get_virtualization(&v);
     877  
     878          r = asprintf(&json,
     879                       "{ \"machine_id\" : \"" SD_ID128_FORMAT_STR "\","
     880                       "\"boot_id\" : \"" SD_ID128_FORMAT_STR "\","
     881                       "\"hostname\" : \"%s\","
     882                       "\"os_pretty_name\" : \"%s\","
     883                       "\"virtualization\" : \"%s\","
     884                       "\"usage\" : \"%"PRIu64"\","
     885                       "\"cutoff_from_realtime\" : \"%"PRIu64"\","
     886                       "\"cutoff_to_realtime\" : \"%"PRIu64"\" }\n",
     887                       SD_ID128_FORMAT_VAL(mid),
     888                       SD_ID128_FORMAT_VAL(bid),
     889                       hostname_cleanup(hostname),
     890                       os_release_pretty_name(pretty_name, os_name),
     891                       v ?: "bare",
     892                       usage,
     893                       cutoff_from,
     894                       cutoff_to);
     895          if (r < 0)
     896                  return respond_oom(connection);
     897  
     898          response = MHD_create_response_from_buffer(strlen(json), json, MHD_RESPMEM_MUST_FREE);
     899          if (!response)
     900                  return respond_oom(connection);
     901          TAKE_PTR(json);
     902  
     903          if (MHD_add_response_header(response, "Content-Type", "application/json") == MHD_NO)
     904                  return respond_oom(connection);
     905  
     906          return MHD_queue_response(connection, MHD_HTTP_OK, response);
     907  }
     908  
     909  static int output_boot(FILE *f, LogId boot, int boot_display_index) {
     910          _cleanup_(sd_json_variant_unrefp) sd_json_variant *json = NULL;
     911          int r;
     912  
     913          r = sd_json_build(
     914                          &json,
     915                          SD_JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(
     916                                          SD_JSON_BUILD_PAIR_INTEGER("index", boot_display_index),
     917                                          SD_JSON_BUILD_PAIR_ID128("boot_id", boot.id),
     918                                          SD_JSON_BUILD_PAIR_UNSIGNED("first_entry", boot.first_usec),
     919                                          SD_JSON_BUILD_PAIR_UNSIGNED("last_entry", boot.last_usec)));
     920          if (r < 0)
     921                  return r;
     922  
     923          return sd_json_variant_dump(json, SD_JSON_FORMAT_SEQ, f, /* prefix= */ NULL);
     924  }
     925  
     926  static ssize_t request_reader_boots(
     927                  void *cls,
     928                  uint64_t pos,
     929                  char *buf,
     930                  size_t max) {
     931  
     932          RequestMeta *m = ASSERT_PTR(cls);
     933          int r;
     934  
     935          assert(buf);
     936          assert(max > 0);
     937          assert(pos >= m->delta);
     938  
     939          pos -= m->delta;
     940  
     941          while (pos >= m->size) {
     942                  LogId boot;
     943                  off_t sz;
     944  
     945                  /* We're seeking from tail (newest boot) so advance to older. */
     946                  r = discover_next_id(
     947                                  m->journal,
     948                                  LOG_BOOT_ID,
     949                                  /* boot_id */ SD_ID128_NULL,
     950                                  /* unit= */ NULL,
     951                                  m->previous_boot_id,
     952                                  /* advance_older= */ true,
     953                                  &boot);
     954                  if (r < 0) {
     955                          log_error_errno(r, "Failed to advance boot index: %m");
     956                          return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_WITH_ERROR;
     957                  }
     958                  if (r == 0)
     959                          return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_OF_STREAM;
     960  
     961                  pos -= m->size;
     962                  m->delta += m->size;
     963  
     964                  r = request_meta_ensure_tmp(m);
     965                  if (r < 0) {
     966                          log_error_errno(r, "Failed to create temporary file: %m");
     967                          return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_WITH_ERROR;
     968                  }
     969  
     970                  r = output_boot(m->tmp, boot, m->boot_index);
     971                  if (r < 0) {
     972                          log_error_errno(r, "Failed to serialize boot: %m");
     973                          return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_WITH_ERROR;
     974                  }
     975  
     976                  sz = ftello(m->tmp);
     977                  if (sz < 0) {
     978                          log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to retrieve file position: %m");
     979                          return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_WITH_ERROR;
     980                  }
     981  
     982                  m->size = (uint64_t) sz;
     983  
     984                  m->previous_boot_id = boot.id;
     985                  m->boot_index -= 1;
     986          }
     987  
     988          if (fseeko(m->tmp, pos, SEEK_SET) < 0) {
     989                  log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to seek to position: %m");
     990                  return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_WITH_ERROR;
     991          }
     992  
     993          size_t n = MIN(m->size - pos, max);
     994  
     995          errno = 0;
     996          size_t k = fread(buf, 1, n, m->tmp);
     997          if (k != n) {
     998                  log_error("Failed to read from file: %s", STRERROR_OR_EOF(errno));
     999                  return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_WITH_ERROR;
    1000          }
    1001  
    1002          return (ssize_t) k;
    1003  }
    1004  
    1005  static int request_handler_boots(
    1006                  struct MHD_Connection *connection,
    1007                  void *connection_cls) {
    1008  
    1009          _cleanup_(MHD_destroy_responsep) struct MHD_Response *response = NULL;
    1010          RequestMeta *m = ASSERT_PTR(connection_cls);
    1011          int r;
    1012  
    1013          assert(connection);
    1014  
    1015          r = open_journal(m);
    1016          if (r < 0)
    1017                  return mhd_respondf(connection, r, MHD_HTTP_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Failed to open journal: %m");
    1018  
    1019          m->previous_boot_id = SD_ID128_NULL;
    1020          m->boot_index = 0;
    1021          r = sd_journal_seek_tail(m->journal); /* seek to newest */
    1022          if (r < 0)
    1023                  return mhd_respondf(connection, r, MHD_HTTP_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Failed to seek in journal: %m");
    1024  
    1025          response = MHD_create_response_from_callback(MHD_SIZE_UNKNOWN, 4*1024, request_reader_boots, m, NULL);
    1026          if (!response)
    1027                  return respond_oom(connection);
    1028  
    1029          if (MHD_add_response_header(response, "Content-Type", "application/json-seq") == MHD_NO)
    1030                  return respond_oom(connection);
    1031  
    1032          return MHD_queue_response(connection, MHD_HTTP_OK, response);
    1033  }
    1034  
    1035  static mhd_result request_handler(
    1036                  void *cls,
    1037                  struct MHD_Connection *connection,
    1038                  const char *url,
    1039                  const char *method,
    1040                  const char *version,
    1041                  const char *upload_data,
    1042                  size_t *upload_data_size,
    1043                  void **connection_cls) {
    1044          int r, code;
    1045  
    1046          assert(connection);
    1047          assert(connection_cls);
    1048          assert(url);
    1049          assert(method);
    1050  
    1051          if (!streq(method, "GET"))
    1052                  return mhd_respond(connection, MHD_HTTP_NOT_ACCEPTABLE, "Unsupported method.");
    1053  
    1054          if (!*connection_cls) {
    1055                  if (!request_meta(connection_cls))
    1056                          return respond_oom(connection);
    1057                  return MHD_YES;
    1058          }
    1059  
    1060          if (arg_trust_pem) {
    1061                  r = check_permissions(connection, &code, NULL);
    1062                  if (r < 0)
    1063                          return code;
    1064          }
    1065  
    1066          if (streq(url, "/"))
    1067                  return request_handler_redirect(connection, "/browse");
    1068  
    1069          if (streq(url, "/entries"))
    1070                  return request_handler_entries(connection, *connection_cls);
    1071  
    1072          if (startswith(url, "/fields/"))
    1073                  return request_handler_fields(connection, url + 8, *connection_cls);
    1074  
    1075          if (streq(url, "/browse"))
    1076                  return request_handler_file(connection, DOCUMENT_ROOT "/browse.html", "text/html");
    1077  
    1078          if (streq(url, "/machine"))
    1079                  return request_handler_machine(connection, *connection_cls);
    1080  
    1081          if (streq(url, "/boots"))
    1082                  return request_handler_boots(connection, *connection_cls);
    1083  
    1084          return mhd_respond(connection, MHD_HTTP_NOT_FOUND, "Not found.");
    1085  }

    1087  static int help(void) {
    1088          _cleanup_free_ char *link = NULL;
    1089          int r;
    1090  
    1091          r = terminal_urlify_man("systemd-journal-gatewayd.service", "8", &link);
    1092          if (r < 0)
    1093                  return log_oom();
    1094  
    1095          printf("%s [OPTIONS...] ...\n\n"
    1096                 "HTTP server for journal events.\n\n"
    1097                 "  -h --help           Show this help\n"
    1098                 "     --version        Show package version\n"
    1099                 "     --cert=CERT.PEM  Server certificate in PEM format\n"
    1100                 "     --key=KEY.PEM    Server key in PEM format\n"
    1101                 "     --trust=CERT.PEM Certificate authority certificate in PEM format\n"
    1102                 "     --system         Serve system journal\n"
    1103                 "     --user           Serve the user journal for the current user\n"
    1104                 "  -m --merge          Serve all available journals\n"
    1105                 "  -D --directory=PATH Serve journal files in directory\n"
    1106                 "     --file=PATH      Serve this journal file\n"
    1107                 "\nSee the %s for details.\n",
    1108                 program_invocation_short_name,
    1109                 link);
    1110  
    1111          return 0;
    1112  }
    1113  
    1114  static int parse_argv(int argc, char *argv[]) {
    1115          enum {
    1116                  ARG_VERSION = 0x100,
    1117                  ARG_KEY,
    1118                  ARG_CERT,
    1119                  ARG_TRUST,
    1120                  ARG_USER,
    1121                  ARG_SYSTEM,
    1122                  ARG_MERGE,
    1123                  ARG_FILE,
    1124          };
    1125  
    1126          int r, c;
    1127  
    1128          static const struct option options[] = {
    1129                  { "help",      no_argument,       NULL, 'h'           },
    1130                  { "version",   no_argument,       NULL, ARG_VERSION   },
    1131                  { "key",       required_argument, NULL, ARG_KEY       },
    1132                  { "cert",      required_argument, NULL, ARG_CERT      },
    1133                  { "trust",     required_argument, NULL, ARG_TRUST     },
    1134                  { "user",      no_argument,       NULL, ARG_USER      },
    1135                  { "system",    no_argument,       NULL, ARG_SYSTEM    },
    1136                  { "merge",     no_argument,       NULL, 'm'           },
    1137                  { "directory", required_argument, NULL, 'D'           },
    1138                  { "file",      required_argument, NULL, ARG_FILE      },
    1139                  {}
    1140          };
    1141  
    1142          assert(argc >= 0);
    1143          assert(argv);
    1144  
    1145          while ((c = getopt_long(argc, argv, "hD:", options, NULL)) >= 0)
    1146  
    1147                  switch (c) {
    1148  
    1149                  case 'h':
    1150                          return help();
    1151  
    1152                  case ARG_VERSION:
    1153                          return version();
    1154  
    1155                  case ARG_KEY:
    1156                          if (arg_key_pem)
    1157                                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL),
    1158                                                         "Key file specified twice");
    1159                          r = read_full_file_full(
    1160                                          AT_FDCWD, optarg, UINT64_MAX, SIZE_MAX,
    1161                                          READ_FULL_FILE_SECURE|READ_FULL_FILE_WARN_WORLD_READABLE|READ_FULL_FILE_CONNECT_SOCKET,
    1162                                          NULL,
    1163                                          &arg_key_pem, NULL);
    1164                          if (r < 0)
    1165                                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to read key file: %m");
    1166                          assert(arg_key_pem);
    1167                          break;
    1168  
    1169                  case ARG_CERT:
    1170                          if (arg_cert_pem)
    1171                                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL),
    1172                                                         "Certificate file specified twice");
    1173                          r = read_full_file_full(
    1174                                          AT_FDCWD, optarg, UINT64_MAX, SIZE_MAX,
    1175                                          READ_FULL_FILE_CONNECT_SOCKET,
    1176                                          NULL,
    1177                                          &arg_cert_pem, NULL);
    1178                          if (r < 0)
    1179                                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to read certificate file: %m");
    1180                          assert(arg_cert_pem);
    1181                          break;
    1182  
    1183                  case ARG_TRUST:
    1184  #if HAVE_GNUTLS
    1185                          if (arg_trust_pem)
    1186                                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL),
    1187                                                         "CA certificate file specified twice");
    1188                          r = read_full_file_full(
    1189                                          AT_FDCWD, optarg, UINT64_MAX, SIZE_MAX,
    1190                                          READ_FULL_FILE_CONNECT_SOCKET,
    1191                                          NULL,
    1192                                          &arg_trust_pem, NULL);
    1193                          if (r < 0)
    1194                                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to read CA certificate file: %m");
    1195                          assert(arg_trust_pem);
    1196                          break;
    1197  #else
    1198                          return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL),
    1199                                                 "Option --trust= is not available.");
    1200  #endif
    1201  
    1202                  case ARG_SYSTEM:
    1203                          arg_journal_type |= SD_JOURNAL_SYSTEM;
    1204                          break;
    1205

     155  static ssize_t request_reader_entries(
     156                  void *cls,
     157                  uint64_t pos,
     158                  char *buf,
     159                  size_t max) {
     160  
     161          RequestMeta *m = ASSERT_PTR(cls);
     162          dual_timestamp previous_ts = DUAL_TIMESTAMP_NULL;
     163          sd_id128_t previous_boot_id = SD_ID128_NULL;
     164          int r;
     165          size_t n, k;

     167          assert(buf);
     168          assert(max > 0);

     171          pos -= m->delta;

     173          while (pos >= m->size) {

     180                  if (m->n_entries_set &&

     184                  if (m->n_skip < 0)
     185                          r = sd_journal_previous_skip(m->journal, (uint64_t) -m->n_skip + 1);

     188                          if (r < 0) {
     189                                  log_error_errno(r, "Failed to skip journal entries: %m");
     190                                  return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_WITH_ERROR;
     191                          }

     193                           * from it are not returned. */

     195                                  m->n_skip -= r;

     197                                  if (!m->follow)
     198                                          return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_OF_STREAM;
     199                                  wait_for_events = true;
     200                          }
     201                  } else
     202                          r = sd_journal_next(m->journal);
     203  
     204                  if (r < 0) {
     205                          log_error_errno(r, "Failed to advance journal pointer: %m");
     206                          return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_WITH_ERROR;
     207                  } else if (r == 0) {
     208                          if (!m->follow)
     209                                  return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_OF_STREAM;

     211                  }
     212  
     213                  if (wait_for_events) {

     215                          if (r < 0) {
     216                                  log_error_errno(r, "Couldn't wait for journal event: %m");

     227  
     228                          r = sd_journal_test_cursor(m->journal, m->cursor);

     230                                  log_error_errno(r, "Failed to test cursor: %m");
     231                                  return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_WITH_ERROR;
     232                          }
     233  
     234                          if (r == 0)
     235                                  return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_OF_STREAM;
     236                  }
     237  
     238                  if (m->until_set) {
     239                          usec_t usec;
     240  
     241                          r = sd_journal_get_realtime_usec(m->journal, &usec);

     243                                  log_error_errno(r, "Failed to determine timestamp: %m");
     244                                  return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_WITH_ERROR;
     245                          }

     252                  if (m->n_entries_set)

     255                  m->n_skip = 0;

     257                  r = request_meta_ensure_tmp(m);
     258                  if (r < 0) {

     260                          return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_WITH_ERROR;

     262  
     263                  r = show_journal_entry(m->tmp, m->journal, m->mode, 0, OUTPUT_FULL_WIDTH,

     265                  if (r < 0) {
     266                          log_error_errno(r, "Failed to serialize item: %m");

     272                          log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to retrieve file position: %m");

     282          if (fseeko(m->tmp, pos, SEEK_SET) < 0) {

     287          n = m->size - pos;
     288          if (n < 1)

     293          errno = 0;

     298          }
     299  
     300          return (ssize_t) k;
     301  }

     303  static int request_parse_accept(
     304                  RequestMeta *m,
     305                  struct MHD_Connection *connection) {
     306  
     307          const char *header;
     308  
     309          assert(m);
     310          assert(connection);
     311  
     312          header = MHD_lookup_connection_value(connection, MHD_HEADER_KIND, "Accept");
     313          if (!header)
     314                  return 0;
     315  
     316          if (streq(header, mime_types[OUTPUT_JSON]))
     317                  m->mode = OUTPUT_JSON;
     318          else if (streq(header, mime_types[OUTPUT_JSON_SSE]))
     319                  m->mode = OUTPUT_JSON_SSE;
     320          else if (streq(header, mime_types[OUTPUT_JSON_SEQ]))
     321                  m->mode = OUTPUT_JSON_SEQ;
     322          else if (streq(header, mime_types[OUTPUT_EXPORT]))
     323                  m->mode = OUTPUT_EXPORT;
     324          else
     325                  m->mode = OUTPUT_SHORT;
     326  
     327          return 0;
     328  }

     330  static int request_parse_range_skip_and_n_entries(
     331                  RequestMeta *m,
     332                  const char *colon) {
     333  
     334          const char *p, *colon2;
     335          int r;
     336  
     337          colon2 = strchr(colon + 1, ':');
     338          if (colon2) {
     339                  _cleanup_free_ char *t = NULL;
     340  
     341                  t = strndup(colon + 1, colon2 - colon - 1);
     342                  if (!t)
     343                          return -ENOMEM;
     344  
     345                  r = safe_atoi64(t, &m->n_skip);
     346                  if (r < 0)
     347                          return r;
     348          }
     349  
     350          p = (colon2 ?: colon) + 1;
     351          if (!isempty(p)) {
     352                  r = safe_atou64(p, &m->n_entries);
     353                  if (r < 0)
     354                          return r;
     355  
     356                  if (m->n_entries <= 0)
     357                          return -EINVAL;
     358  
     359                  m->n_entries_set = true;
     360          }
     361  
     362          return 0;
     363  }

     365  static int request_parse_range_entries(
     366                  RequestMeta *m,
     367                  const char *entries_request) {
     368  
     369          const char *colon;
     370          int r;
     371  
     372          assert(m);
     373          assert(entries_request);
     374  
     375          colon = strchr(entries_request, ':');
     376          if (!colon)
     377                  m->cursor = strdup(entries_request);

     390                  m->cursor = mfree(m->cursor);

     392          return 0;

     451  static int request_parse_range(
     452                  RequestMeta *m,
     453                  struct MHD_Connection *connection) {

     504                          m->argument_parse_error = r;
     505                          return MHD_NO;
     506                  }
     507  
     508                  m->follow = r;
     509                  return MHD_YES;
     510          }
     511  
     512          if (streq(key, "discrete")) {
     513                  if (isempty(value)) {
     514                          m->discrete = true;
     515                          return MHD_YES;
     516                  }
     517  
     518                  r = parse_boolean(value);
     519                  if (r < 0) {
     520                          m->argument_parse_error = r;
     521                          return MHD_NO;
     522                  }
     523  
     524                  m->discrete = r;
     525                  return MHD_YES;
     526          }
     527  
     528          if (streq(key, "boot")) {
     529                  if (isempty(value))
     530                          r = true;
     531                  else {
     532                          r = parse_boolean(value);
     533                          if (r < 0) {
     534                                  m->argument_parse_error = r;
     535                                  return MHD_NO;
     536                          }
     537                  }
     538  
     539                  if (r) {
     540                          r = add_match_boot_id(m->journal, SD_ID128_NULL);
     541                          if (r < 0) {
     542                                  m->argument_parse_error = r;
     543                                  return MHD_NO;
     544                          }
     545                  }
     546  
     547                  return MHD_YES;
     548          }
     549  
     550          r = journal_add_match_pair(m->journal, key, strempty(value));
     551          if (r < 0) {
     552                  m->argument_parse_error = r;
     553                  return MHD_NO;
     554          }
     555  
     556          return MHD_YES;
     557  }

     559  static int request_parse_arguments(
     560                  RequestMeta *m,
     561                  struct MHD_Connection *connection) {
     562  
     563          assert(m);
     564          assert(connection);
     565  
     566          m->argument_parse_error = 0;
     567          MHD_get_connection_values(connection, MHD_GET_ARGUMENT_KIND, request_parse_arguments_iterator, m);
     568  
     569          return m->argument_parse_error;
     570  }
     571  
     572  static int request_handler_entries(
     573                  struct MHD_Connection *connection,
     574                  void *connection_cls) {
     575  
     576          _cleanup_(MHD_destroy_responsep) struct MHD_Response *response = NULL;
     577          RequestMeta *m = ASSERT_PTR(connection_cls);
     578          int r;
     579  
     580          assert(connection);
     581  
     582          r = open_journal(m);
     583          if (r < 0)
     584                  return mhd_respondf(connection, r, MHD_HTTP_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Failed to open journal: %m");
     585  
     586          if (request_parse_accept(m, connection) < 0)
     587                  return mhd_respond(connection, MHD_HTTP_BAD_REQUEST, "Failed to parse Accept header.");
     588  
     589          if (request_parse_range(m, connection) < 0)
     590                  return mhd_respond(connection, MHD_HTTP_BAD_REQUEST, "Failed to parse Range header.");
     591  
     592          if (request_parse_arguments(m, connection) < 0)
     593                  return mhd_respond(connection, MHD_HTTP_BAD_REQUEST, "Failed to parse URL arguments.");
     594  
     595          if (m->discrete) {
     596                  if (!m->cursor)
     597                          return mhd_respond(connection, MHD_HTTP_BAD_REQUEST, "Discrete seeks require a cursor specification.");
     598  
     599                  m->n_entries = 1;
     600                  m->n_entries_set = true;
     601          }
     602  
     603          if (m->cursor)
     604                  r = sd_journal_seek_cursor(m->journal, m->cursor);
     605          else if (m->since_set)
     606                  r = sd_journal_seek_realtime_usec(m->journal, m->since);
     607          else if (m->n_skip >= 0)
     608                  r = sd_journal_seek_head(m->journal);
     609          else if (m->until_set && m->n_skip < 0)
     610                  r = sd_journal_seek_realtime_usec(m->journal, m->until);
     611          else if (m->n_skip < 0)
     612                  r = sd_journal_seek_tail(m->journal);
     613  
     614          if (r < 0)
     615                  return mhd_respond(connection, MHD_HTTP_BAD_REQUEST, "Failed to seek in journal.");
     616  
     617          response = MHD_create_response_from_callback(MHD_SIZE_UNKNOWN, 4*1024, request_reader_entries, m, NULL);
     618          if (!response)
     619                  return respond_oom(connection);
     620  
     621          if (MHD_add_response_header(response, "Content-Type", mime_types[m->mode]) == MHD_NO)
     622                  return respond_oom(connection);
     623  
     624          return MHD_queue_response(connection, MHD_HTTP_OK, response);
     625  }
     626  
     627  static int output_field(FILE *f, OutputMode m, const char *d, size_t l) {
     628          const char *eq;
     629          size_t j;
     630  
     631          eq = memchr(d, '=', l);
     632          if (!eq)
     633                  return -EINVAL;
     634  
     635          j = l - (eq - d + 1);
     636  
     637          if (m == OUTPUT_JSON) {
     638                  fprintf(f, "{ \"%.*s\" : ", (int) (eq - d), d);
     639                  json_escape(f, eq+1, j, OUTPUT_FULL_WIDTH);
     640                  fputs(" }\n", f);
     641          } else {
     642                  fwrite(eq+1, 1, j, f);
     643                  fputc('\n', f);
     644          }
     645  
     646          return 0;
     647  }
     648  
     649  static ssize_t request_reader_fields(
     650                  void *cls,
     651                  uint64_t pos,
     652                  char *buf,
     653                  size_t max) {
     654  
     655          RequestMeta *m = ASSERT_PTR(cls);
     656          int r;
     657          size_t n, k;
     658  
     659          assert(buf);
     660          assert(max > 0);
     661          assert(pos >= m->delta);
     662  
     663          pos -= m->delta;
     664  
     665          while (pos >= m->size) {
     666                  off_t sz;
     667                  const void *d;
     668                  size_t l;
     669  
     670                  /* End of this field, so let's serialize the next
     671                   * one */
     672  
     673                  r = sd_journal_enumerate_unique(m->journal, &d, &l);
     674                  if (r < 0) {
     675                          log_error_errno(r, "Failed to advance field index: %m");
     676                          return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_WITH_ERROR;
     677                  } else if (r == 0)
     678                          return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_OF_STREAM;
     679  
     680                  pos -= m->size;
     681                  m->delta += m->size;
     682  
     683                  r = request_meta_ensure_tmp(m);
     684                  if (r < 0) {
     685                          log_error_errno(r, "Failed to create temporary file: %m");
     686                          return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_WITH_ERROR;
     687                  }
     688  
     689                  r = output_field(m->tmp, m->mode, d, l);
     690                  if (r < 0) {
     691                          log_error_errno(r, "Failed to serialize item: %m");
     692                          return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_WITH_ERROR;
     693                  }
     694  
     695                  sz = ftello(m->tmp);
     696                  if (sz < 0) {
     697                          log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to retrieve file position: %m");
     698                          return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_WITH_ERROR;
     699                  }
     700  
     701                  m->size = (uint64_t) sz;
     702          }
     703  
     704          if (fseeko(m->tmp, pos, SEEK_SET) < 0) {
     705                  log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to seek to position: %m");
     706                  return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_WITH_ERROR;
     707          }
     708  
     709          n = m->size - pos;
     710          if (n > max)
     711                  n = max;
     712  
     713          errno = 0;
     714          k = fread(buf, 1, n, m->tmp);
     715          if (k != n) {
     716                  log_error("Failed to read from file: %s", STRERROR_OR_EOF(errno));
     717                  return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_WITH_ERROR;
     718          }
     719  
     720          return (ssize_t) k;
     721  }

     723  static int request_handler_fields(
     724                  struct MHD_Connection *connection,
     725                  const char *field,
     726                  void *connection_cls) {
     727  
     728          _cleanup_(MHD_destroy_responsep) struct MHD_Response *response = NULL;
     729          RequestMeta *m = ASSERT_PTR(connection_cls);
     730          int r;
     731  
     732          assert(connection);
     733  
     734          r = open_journal(m);
     735          if (r < 0)
     736                  return mhd_respondf(connection, r, MHD_HTTP_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Failed to open journal: %m");
     737  
     738          if (request_parse_accept(m, connection) < 0)
     739                  return mhd_respond(connection, MHD_HTTP_BAD_REQUEST, "Failed to parse Accept header.");
     740  
     741          r = sd_journal_query_unique(m->journal, field);
     742          if (r < 0)
     743                  return mhd_respond(connection, MHD_HTTP_BAD_REQUEST, "Failed to query unique fields.");
     744  
     745          response = MHD_create_response_from_callback(MHD_SIZE_UNKNOWN, 4*1024, request_reader_fields, m, NULL);

     749          if (MHD_add_response_header(response, "Content-Type", mime_types[m->mode == OUTPUT_JSON ? OUTPUT_JSON : OUTPUT_SHORT]) == MHD_NO)
     750                  return respond_oom(connection);

     752          return MHD_queue_response(connection, MHD_HTTP_OK, response);
     753  }

     834  static int request_handler_machine(
     835                  struct MHD_Connection *connection,
     836                  void *connection_cls) {
     837  
     838          _cleanup_(MHD_destroy_responsep) struct MHD_Response *response = NULL;
     839          RequestMeta *m = ASSERT_PTR(connection_cls);
     840          int r;
     841          _cleanup_free_ char *hostname = NULL, *pretty_name = NULL, *os_name = NULL;
     842          uint64_t cutoff_from = 0, cutoff_to = 0, usage = 0;
     843          sd_id128_t mid, bid;
     844          _cleanup_free_ char *v = NULL, *json = NULL;

     846          assert(connection);
     847  
     848          r = open_journal(m);
     849          if (r < 0)
     850                  return mhd_respondf(connection, r, MHD_HTTP_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Failed to open journal: %m");
     851  
     852          r = sd_id128_get_machine(&mid);
     853          if (r < 0)
     854                  return mhd_respondf(connection, r, MHD_HTTP_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Failed to determine machine ID: %m");
     855  
     856          r = sd_id128_get_boot(&bid);
     857          if (r < 0)

     867  
     868          r = sd_journal_get_cutoff_realtime_usec(m->journal, &cutoff_from, &cutoff_to);
     869          if (r < 0)
     870                  return mhd_respondf(connection, r, MHD_HTTP_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Failed to determine disk usage: %m");
     871  
     872          (void) parse_os_release(
     873                          NULL,
     874                          "PRETTY_NAME", &pretty_name,
     875                          "NAME=", &os_name);
     876          (void) get_virtualization(&v);
     877  
     878          r = asprintf(&json,
     879                       "{ \"machine_id\" : \"" SD_ID128_FORMAT_STR "\","
     880                       "\"boot_id\" : \"" SD_ID128_FORMAT_STR "\","
     881                       "\"hostname\" : \"%s\","
     882                       "\"os_pretty_name\" : \"%s\","
     883                       "\"virtualization\" : \"%s\","
     884                       "\"usage\" : \"%"PRIu64"\","
     885                       "\"cutoff_from_realtime\" : \"%"PRIu64"\","
     886                       "\"cutoff_to_realtime\" : \"%"PRIu64"\" }\n",
     887                       SD_ID128_FORMAT_VAL(mid),
     888                       SD_ID128_FORMAT_VAL(bid),
     889                       hostname_cleanup(hostname),
     890                       os_release_pretty_name(pretty_name, os_name),
     891                       v ?: "bare",
     892                       usage,
     893                       cutoff_from,
     894                       cutoff_to);
     895          if (r < 0)
     896                  return respond_oom(connection);
     897  
     898          response = MHD_create_response_from_buffer(strlen(json), json, MHD_RESPMEM_MUST_FREE);
     899          if (!response)
     900                  return respond_oom(connection);
     901          TAKE_PTR(json);
     902  
     903          if (MHD_add_response_header(response, "Content-Type", "application/json") == MHD_NO)
     904                  return respond_oom(connection);
     905  
     906          return MHD_queue_response(connection, MHD_HTTP_OK, response);
     907  }

     909  static int output_boot(FILE *f, LogId boot, int boot_display_index) {
     910          _cleanup_(sd_json_variant_unrefp) sd_json_variant *json = NULL;
     911          int r;
     912  
     913          r = sd_json_build(
     914                          &json,
     915                          SD_JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(
     916                                          SD_JSON_BUILD_PAIR_INTEGER("index", boot_display_index),
     917                                          SD_JSON_BUILD_PAIR_ID128("boot_id", boot.id),
     918                                          SD_JSON_BUILD_PAIR_UNSIGNED("first_entry", boot.first_usec),
     919                                          SD_JSON_BUILD_PAIR_UNSIGNED("last_entry", boot.last_usec)));
     920          if (r < 0)
     921                  return r;
     922  
     923          return sd_json_variant_dump(json, SD_JSON_FORMAT_SEQ, f, /* prefix= */ NULL);
     924  }
     925  
     926  static ssize_t request_reader_boots(
     927                  void *cls,
     928                  uint64_t pos,
     929                  char *buf,
     930                  size_t max) {
     931  
     932          RequestMeta *m = ASSERT_PTR(cls);
     933          int r;
     934  
     935          assert(buf);
     936          assert(max > 0);
     937          assert(pos >= m->delta);
     938  
     939          pos -= m->delta;
     940  
     941          while (pos >= m->size) {
     942                  LogId boot;
     943                  off_t sz;
     944  
     945                  /* We're seeking from tail (newest boot) so advance to older. */
     946                  r = discover_next_id(
     947                                  m->journal,
     948                                  LOG_BOOT_ID,
     949                                  /* boot_id */ SD_ID128_NULL,
     950                                  /* unit= */ NULL,
     951                                  m->previous_boot_id,
     952                                  /* advance_older= */ true,
     953                                  &boot);
     954                  if (r < 0) {
     955                          log_error_errno(r, "Failed to advance boot index: %m");
     956                          return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_WITH_ERROR;
     957                  }
     958                  if (r == 0)
     959                          return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_OF_STREAM;
     960  
     961                  pos -= m->size;
     962                  m->delta += m->size;
     963  
     964                  r = request_meta_ensure_tmp(m);
     965                  if (r < 0) {
     966                          log_error_errno(r, "Failed to create temporary file: %m");
     967                          return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_WITH_ERROR;
     968                  }
     969  
     970                  r = output_boot(m->tmp, boot, m->boot_index);
     971                  if (r < 0) {
     972                          log_error_errno(r, "Failed to serialize boot: %m");
     973                          return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_WITH_ERROR;
     974                  }
     975  
     976                  sz = ftello(m->tmp);
     977                  if (sz < 0) {
     978                          log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to retrieve file position: %m");
     979                          return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_WITH_ERROR;
     980                  }
     981  
     982                  m->size = (uint64_t) sz;
     983  
     984                  m->previous_boot_id = boot.id;
     985                  m->boot_index -= 1;
     986          }
     987  
     988          if (fseeko(m->tmp, pos, SEEK_SET) < 0) {
     989                  log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to seek to position: %m");
     990                  return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_WITH_ERROR;
     991          }
     992  
     993          size_t n = MIN(m->size - pos, max);
     994  
     995          errno = 0;
     996          size_t k = fread(buf, 1, n, m->tmp);
     997          if (k != n) {
     998                  log_error("Failed to read from file: %s", STRERROR_OR_EOF(errno));
     999                  return MHD_CONTENT_READER_END_WITH_ERROR;
    1000          }
    1001  
    1002          return (ssize_t) k;
    1003  }
    1004  
    1005  static int request_handler_boots(
    1006                  struct MHD_Connection *connection,
    1007                  void *connection_cls) {
    1008  
    1009          _cleanup_(MHD_destroy_responsep) struct MHD_Response *response = NULL;
    1010          RequestMeta *m = ASSERT_PTR(connection_cls);
    1011          int r;
    1012  
    1013          assert(connection);
    1014  
    1015          r = open_journal(m);
    1016          if (r < 0)
    1017                  return mhd_respondf(connection, r, MHD_HTTP_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Failed to open journal: %m");
    1018  
    1019          m->previous_boot_id = SD_ID128_NULL;
    1020          m->boot_index = 0;
    1021          r = sd_journal_seek_tail(m->journal); /* seek to newest */
    1022          if (r < 0)
    1023                  return mhd_respondf(connection, r, MHD_HTTP_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Failed to seek in journal: %m");
    1024  
    1025          response = MHD_create_response_from_callback(MHD_SIZE_UNKNOWN, 4*1024, request_reader_boots, m, NULL);
    1026          if (!response)
    1027                  return respond_oom(connection);
    1028  
    1029          if (MHD_add_response_header(response, "Content-Type", "application/json-seq") == MHD_NO)
    1030                  return respond_oom(connection);
    1031  
    1032          return MHD_queue_response(connection, MHD_HTTP_OK, response);
    1033  }
    1034  
    1035  static mhd_result request_handler(
    1036                  void *cls,
    1037                  struct MHD_Connection *connection,
    1038                  const char *url,
    1039                  const char *method,
    1040                  const char *version,
    1041                  const char *upload_data,
    1042                  size_t *upload_data_size,
    1043                  void **connection_cls) {
    1044          int r, code;
    1045  
    1046          assert(connection);
    1047          assert(connection_cls);
    1048          assert(url);
    1049          assert(method);
    1050  
    1051          if (!streq(method, "GET"))
    1052                  return mhd_respond(connection, MHD_HTTP_NOT_ACCEPTABLE, "Unsupported method.");
    1053  
    1054          if (!*connection_cls) {
    1055                  if (!request_meta(connection_cls))
    1056                          return respond_oom(connection);
    1057                  return MHD_YES;
    1058          }
    1059  
    1060          if (arg_trust_pem) {
    1061                  r = check_permissions(connection, &code, NULL);
    1062                  if (r < 0)
    1063                          return code;
    1064          }
    1065  
    1066          if (streq(url, "/"))
    1067                  return request_handler_redirect(connection, "/browse");
    1068  
    1069          if (streq(url, "/entries"))
    1070                  return request_handler_entries(connection, *connection_cls);
    1071  
    1072          if (startswith(url, "/fields/"))
    1073                  return request_handler_fields(connection, url + 8, *connection_cls);
    1074  
    1075          if (streq(url, "/browse"))
    1076                  return request_handler_file(connection, DOCUMENT_ROOT "/browse.html", "text/html");
    1077  
    1078          if (streq(url, "/machine"))
    1079                  return request_handler_machine(connection, *connection_cls);
    1080  
    1081          if (streq(url, "/boots"))
    1082                  return request_handler_boots(connection, *connection_cls);
    1083  
    1084          return mhd_respond(connection, MHD_HTTP_NOT_FOUND, "Not found.");
    1085  }

    1089          int r;
    1090  
    1091          r = terminal_urlify_man("systemd-journal-gatewayd.service", "8", &link);
    1092          if (r < 0)
    1093                  return log_oom();
    1094  
    1095          printf("%s [OPTIONS...] ...\n\n"
    1096                 "HTTP server for journal events.\n\n"

      59          siphash24_compress_typesafe(i->id, state);
      60          siphash24_compress_string(i->language, state);
      61  }
      62  
      63  static int catalog_compare_func(const CatalogItem *a, const CatalogItem *b) {
      64          int r;
      65  
      66          assert(a);
      67          assert(b);
      68  
      69          for (size_t k = 0; k < ELEMENTSOF(b->id.bytes); k++) {
      70                  r = CMP(a->id.bytes[k], b->id.bytes[k]);
      71                  if (r != 0)
      72                          return r;
      73          }
      74  
      75          return strcmp(a->language, b->language);
      76  }
      77  
      78  DEFINE_PRIVATE_HASH_OPS_FULL(
      79                  catalog_hash_ops,
      80                  CatalogItem, catalog_hash_func, catalog_compare_func, free,
      81                  void, free);
      82  
      83  static bool next_header(const char **s) {
      84          const char *e;
      85  
      86          assert(s);
      87          assert(*s);
      88  
      89          e = strchr(*s, '\n');
      90  
      91          /* Unexpected end */
      92          if (!e)
      93                  return false;
      94  
      95          /* End of headers */
      96          if (e == *s)
      97                  return false;
      98  
      99          *s = e + 1;
     100          return true;
     101  }
     102  
     103  static const char* skip_header(const char *s) {
     104          assert(s);
     105  
     106          while (next_header(&s))
     107                  ;
     108          return s;
     109  }
     110  
     111  static char* combine_entries(const char *one, const char *two) {
     112          const char *b1, *b2;
     113          size_t l1, l2, n;
     114          char *dest, *p;
     115  
     116          assert(one);
     117          assert(two);
     118  
     119          /* Find split point of headers to body */
     120          b1 = skip_header(one);
     121          b2 = skip_header(two);
     122  
     123          l1 = strlen(one);
     124          l2 = strlen(two);
     125          dest = new(char, l1 + l2 + 1);
     126          if (!dest) {
     127                  log_oom();
     128                  return NULL;
     129          }
     130  
     131          p = dest;
     132  
     133          /* Headers from @one */
     134          n = b1 - one;
     135          p = mempcpy(p, one, n);
     136  
     137          /* Headers from @two, these will only be found if not present above */
     138          n = b2 - two;
     139          p = mempcpy(p, two, n);
     140  
     141          /* Body from @one */
     142          n = l1 - (b1 - one);
     143          if (n > 0)
     144                  p = mempcpy(p, b1, n);
     145          /* Body from @two */
     146          else {
     147                  n = l2 - (b2 - two);
     148                  p = mempcpy(p, b2, n);
     149          }
     150  
     151          assert(p - dest <= (ptrdiff_t)(l1 + l2));
     152          p[0] = '\0';
     153          return dest;
     154  }
     155  
     156  static int finish_item(
     157                  OrderedHashmap **h,
     158                  sd_id128_t id,
     159                  const char *language,
     160                  const char *payload,
     161                  size_t payload_size) {
     162  
     163          _cleanup_free_ CatalogItem *i = NULL;
     164          _cleanup_free_ char *combined = NULL;
     165          char *prev;
     166          int r;
     167  
     168          assert(h);
     169          assert(payload);
     170          assert(payload_size > 0);
     171  
     172          i = new0(CatalogItem, 1);
     173          if (!i)
     174                  return log_oom();
     175  
     176          i->id = id;
     177          if (language) {
     178                  assert(strlen(language) > 1 && strlen(language) < 32);
     179                  strcpy(i->language, language);
     180          }
     181  
     182          prev = ordered_hashmap_get(*h, i);
     183          if (prev) {
     184                  /* Already have such an item, combine them */
     185                  combined = combine_entries(payload, prev);
     186                  if (!combined)
     187                          return log_oom();
     188  
     189                  r = ordered_hashmap_update(*h, i, combined);
     190                  if (r < 0)
     191                          return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to update catalog item: %m");
     192  
     193                  TAKE_PTR(combined);
     194                  free(prev);
     195          } else {
     196                  /* A new item */
     197                  combined = memdup(payload, payload_size + 1);
     198                  if (!combined)
     199                          return log_oom();
     200  
     201                  r = ordered_hashmap_ensure_put(h, &catalog_hash_ops, i, combined);
     202                  if (r < 0)
     203                          return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to insert catalog item: %m");
     204  
     205                  TAKE_PTR(i);
     206                  TAKE_PTR(combined);
     207          }
     208  
     209          return 0;
     210  }
     211  
     212  int catalog_file_lang(const char *filename, char **ret) {
     213          assert(filename);
     214          assert(ret);
     215  
     216          const char *end = endswith(filename, ".catalog");
     217          if (!end)
     218                  return 0;
     219  
     220          const char *beg = end - 1;
     221          while (beg > filename && !IN_SET(*beg, '.', '/') && end - beg < 32)
     222                  beg--;
     223  
     224          if (*beg != '.' || end <= beg + 1)
     225                  return 0;
     226  
     227          char *lang = strndup(beg + 1, end - beg - 1);
     228          if (!lang)
     229                  return -ENOMEM;
     230  
     231          *ret = lang;
     232          return 1;
     233  }
     234  
     235  static int catalog_entry_lang(
     236                  const char *filename,
     237                  unsigned line,
     238                  const char *t,
     239                  const char *deflang,
     240                  char **ret) {
     241  
     242          assert(t);
     243  
     244          size_t c = strlen(t);
     245          if (c < 2)
     246                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL),
     247                                         "[%s:%u] Language too short.", filename, line);
     248          if (c > 31)
     249                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL),
     250                                         "[%s:%u] language too long.", filename, line);
     251  
     252          if (deflang) {
     253                  if (streq(t, deflang)) {
     254                          log_warning("[%s:%u] language specified unnecessarily", filename, line);
     255                          return 0;
     256                  }
     257  
     258                  log_warning("[%s:%u] language differs from default for file", filename, line);
     259          }
     260  
     261          return strdup_to(ret, t);
     262  }
     263  
     264  int catalog_import_file(OrderedHashmap **h, int fd, const char *path) {
     265          _cleanup_fclose_ FILE *f = NULL;
     266          _cleanup_free_ char *payload = NULL;
     267          size_t payload_size = 0;
     268          unsigned n = 0;
     269          sd_id128_t id;
     270          _cleanup_free_ char *deflang = NULL, *lang = NULL;
     271          bool got_id = false, empty_line = true;
     272          int r;
     273  
     274          assert(h);
     275          assert(fd >= 0);
     276          assert(path);
     277  
     278          f = fopen(FORMAT_PROC_FD_PATH(fd), "re");
     279          if (!f)
     280                  return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to open file %s: %m", path);
     281  
     282          r = catalog_file_lang(path, &deflang);
     283          if (r < 0)
     284                  log_error_errno(r, "Failed to determine language for file %s: %m", path);
     285          if (r == 1)
     286                  log_debug("File %s has language %s.", path, deflang);
     287  
     288          for (;;) {
     289                  _cleanup_free_ char *line = NULL;
     290                  size_t line_len;
     291  
     292                  r = read_line(f, LONG_LINE_MAX, &line);
     293                  if (r < 0)
     294                          return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to read file %s: %m", path);
     295                  if (r == 0)
     296                          break;
     297  
     298                  n++;
     299  
     300                  if (isempty(line)) {
     301                          empty_line = true;
     302                          continue;
     303                  }
     304  
     305                  if (strchr(COMMENTS, line[0]))
     306                          continue;
     307  
     308                  if (empty_line &&
     309                      strlen(line) >= 2+1+32 &&
     310                      line[0] == '-' &&
     311                      line[1] == '-' &&
     312                      line[2] == ' ' &&
     313                      IN_SET(line[2+1+32], ' ', '\0')) {
     314  
     315                          bool with_language;
     316                          sd_id128_t jd;
     317  
     318                          /* New entry */
     319  
     320                          with_language = line[2+1+32] != '\0';
     321                          line[2+1+32] = '\0';
     322  
     323                          if (sd_id128_from_string(line + 2 + 1, &jd) >= 0) {
     324  
     325                                  if (got_id) {
     326                                          if (payload_size == 0)
     327                                                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL),
     328                                                                         "[%s:%u] No payload text.",
     329                                                                         path,
     330                                                                         n);
     331  
     332                                          r = finish_item(h, id, lang ?: deflang, payload, payload_size);
     333                                          if (r < 0)
     334                                                  return r;
     335  
     336                                          lang = mfree(lang);
     337                                          payload_size = 0;
     338                                  }
     339  
     340                                  if (with_language) {
     341                                          char *t;
     342  
     343                                          t = strstrip(line + 2 + 1 + 32 + 1);
     344                                          r = catalog_entry_lang(path, n, t, deflang, &lang);
     345                                          if (r < 0)
     346                                                  return r;
     347                                  }
     348  
     349                                  got_id = true;
     350                                  empty_line = false;
     351                                  id = jd;
     352  
     353                                  continue;
     354                          }
     355                  }
     356  
     357                  /* Payload */
     358                  if (!got_id)
     359                          return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL),
     360                                                 "[%s:%u] Got payload before ID.",
     361                                                 path, n);
     362  
     363                  line_len = strlen(line);
     364                  if (!GREEDY_REALLOC(payload, payload_size + (empty_line ? 1 : 0) + line_len + 1 + 1))
     365                          return log_oom();
     366  
     367                  if (empty_line)
     368                          payload[payload_size++] = '\n';
     369                  memcpy(payload + payload_size, line, line_len);
     370                  payload_size += line_len;
     371                  payload[payload_size++] = '\n';
     372                  payload[payload_size] = '\0';
     373  
     374                  empty_line = false;
     375          }
     376  
     377          if (got_id) {
     378                  if (payload_size == 0)
     379                          return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL),
     380                                                 "[%s:%u] No payload text.",
     381                                                 path, n);
     382  
     383                  r = finish_item(h, id, lang ?: deflang, payload, payload_size);
     384                  if (r < 0)
     385                          return r;
     386          }
     387  
     388          return 0;
     389  }
     390  
     391  static int64_t write_catalog(
     392                  const char *database,
     393                  const struct strbuf *sb,
     394                  const CatalogItem *items,
     395                  size_t n_items) {
     396  
     397          _cleanup_(unlink_and_freep) char *p = NULL;
     398          _cleanup_fclose_ FILE *w = NULL;
     399          int r;
     400  
     401          assert(database);
     402          assert(sb);
     403          assert(items);
     404          assert(n_items > 0);
     405  
     406          r = mkdir_parents(database, 0755);
     407          if (r < 0)
     408                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to create parent directories of %s: %m", database);
     409  
     410          r = fopen_temporary(database, &w, &p);
     411          if (r < 0)
     412                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to open database for writing: %s: %m", database);
     413  
     414          CatalogHeader header = {
     415                  .signature = CATALOG_SIGNATURE,
     416                  .header_size = htole64(CONST_ALIGN_TO(sizeof(CatalogHeader), 8)),
     417                  .catalog_item_size = htole64(sizeof(CatalogItem)),
     418                  .n_items = htole64(n_items),
     419          };
     420  
     421          if (fwrite(&header, sizeof(header), 1, w) != 1)
     422                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EIO), "%s: failed to write header.", p);
     423  
     424          if (fwrite(items, sizeof(CatalogItem), n_items, w) != n_items)
     425                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EIO), "%s: failed to write database.", p);
     426  
     427          if (fwrite(sb->buf, sb->len, 1, w) != 1)
     428                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EIO), "%s: failed to write strings.", p);
     429  
     430          r = fflush_and_check(w);
     431          if (r < 0)
     432                  return log_error_errno(r, "%s: failed to write database: %m", p);
     433  
     434          (void) fchmod(fileno(w), 0644);
     435  
     436          if (rename(p, database) < 0)
     437                  return log_error_errno(errno, "rename (%s -> %s) failed: %m", p, database);
     438  
     439          p = mfree(p); /* free without unlinking */
     440          return ftello(w);
     441  }
     442  
     443  int catalog_update(const char *database, const char *root, const char* const *dirs) {
     444          int r;
     445  
     446          assert(database);
     447  
     448          if (!dirs)
     449                  dirs = catalog_file_dirs;
     450  
     451          ConfFile **files = NULL;
     452          size_t n_files = 0;
     453  
     454          CLEANUP_ARRAY(files, n_files, conf_file_free_many);
     455  
     456          r = conf_files_list_strv_full(".catalog", root,
     457                                        CONF_FILES_REGULAR | CONF_FILES_FILTER_MASKED | CONF_FILES_WARN,
     458                                        dirs, &files, &n_files);
     459          if (r < 0)
     460                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to get catalog files: %m");
     461  
     462          _cleanup_ordered_hashmap_free_ OrderedHashmap *h = NULL;
     463          FOREACH_ARRAY(i, files, n_files) {
     464                  ConfFile *c = *i;
     465  
     466                  log_debug("Reading file: '%s' -> '%s'", c->original_path, c->resolved_path);
     467                  r = catalog_import_file(&h, c->fd, c->original_path);
     468                  if (r < 0)
     469                          return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to import file '%s': %m", c->original_path);
     470          }
     471  
     472          if (ordered_hashmap_isempty(h)) {
     473                  log_info("No items in catalog.");
     474                  return 0;
     475          }
     476  
     477          log_debug("Found %u items in catalog.", ordered_hashmap_size(h));
     478  
     479          _cleanup_free_ CatalogItem *items = new(CatalogItem, ordered_hashmap_size(h));
     480          if (!items)
     481                  return log_oom();
     482  
     483          _cleanup_(strbuf_freep) struct strbuf *sb = strbuf_new();
     484          if (!sb)
     485                  return log_oom();
     486  
     487          unsigned n = 0;
     488          char *payload;
     489          CatalogItem *i;
     490          ORDERED_HASHMAP_FOREACH_KEY(payload, i, h) {
     491                  log_trace("Found " SD_ID128_FORMAT_STR ", language %s",
     492                            SD_ID128_FORMAT_VAL(i->id),
     493                            isempty(i->language) ? "C" : i->language);
     494  
     495                  ssize_t offset = strbuf_add_string(sb, payload);
     496                  if (offset < 0)
     497                          return log_oom();
     498  
     499                  i->offset = htole64((uint64_t) offset);
     500                  items[n++] = *i;
     501          }
     502  
     503          assert(n == ordered_hashmap_size(h));
     504          typesafe_qsort(items, n, catalog_compare_func);
     505  
     506          strbuf_complete(sb);
     507  
     508          int64_t sz = write_catalog(database, sb, items, n);
     509          if (sz < 0)
     510                  return log_error_errno(sz, "Failed to write %s: %m", database);
     511  
     512          log_debug("%s: wrote %u items, with %zu bytes of strings, %"PRIi64" total size.",
     513                    database, n, sb->len, sz);
     514          return 0;
     515  }
     516  
     517  static int open_mmap(const char *database, int *ret_fd, struct stat *ret_st, void **ret_map) {
     518          assert(database);
     519          assert(ret_fd);
     520          assert(ret_st);
     521          assert(ret_map);
     522  
     523          _cleanup_close_ int fd = open(database, O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC);
     524          if (fd < 0)
     525                  return -errno;
     526  
     527          struct stat st;
     528          if (fstat(fd, &st) < 0)
     529                  return -errno;
     530  
     531          if (st.st_size < (off_t) sizeof(CatalogHeader) || file_offset_beyond_memory_size(st.st_size))
     532                  return -EINVAL;
     533  
     534          void *p = mmap(NULL, st.st_size, PROT_READ, MAP_SHARED, fd, 0);
     535          if (p == MAP_FAILED)
     536                  return -errno;
     537  
     538          const CatalogHeader *h = p;
     539          if (memcmp(h->signature, (const uint8_t[]) CATALOG_SIGNATURE, sizeof(h->signature)) != 0 ||
     540              le64toh(h->header_size) < sizeof(CatalogHeader) ||
     541              le64toh(h->catalog_item_size) < sizeof(CatalogItem) ||
     542              h->incompatible_flags != 0 ||
     543              le64toh(h->n_items) <= 0 ||
     544              st.st_size < (off_t) (le64toh(h->header_size) + le64toh(h->catalog_item_size) * le64toh(h->n_items))) {
     545                  munmap(p, st.st_size);
     546                  return -EBADMSG;
     547          }
     548  
     549          *ret_fd = TAKE_FD(fd);
     550          *ret_st = st;
     551          *ret_map = p;
     552          return 0;
     553  }
     554  
     555  static const char* find_id(const void *p, sd_id128_t id) {
     556          CatalogItem key = { .id = id };
     557          const CatalogItem *f = NULL;
     558          const CatalogHeader *h = ASSERT_PTR(p);
     559          const char *loc;
     560  
     561          loc = setlocale(LC_MESSAGES, NULL);
     562          if (!isempty(loc) && !STR_IN_SET(loc, "C", "POSIX")) {
     563                  size_t len;
     564  
     565                  len = strcspn(loc, ".@");
     566                  if (len > sizeof(key.language) - 1)
     567                          log_debug("LC_MESSAGES value too long, ignoring: \"%.*s\"", (int) len, loc);
     568                  else {
     569                          strncpy(key.language, loc, len);
     570                          key.language[len] = '\0';
     571  
     572                          f = bsearch(&key,
     573                                      (const uint8_t*) p + le64toh(h->header_size),
     574                                      le64toh(h->n_items),
     575                                      le64toh(h->catalog_item_size),
     576                                      (comparison_fn_t) catalog_compare_func);
     577                          if (!f) {
     578                                  char *e;
     579  
     580                                  e = strchr(key.language, '_');
     581                                  if (e) {
     582                                          *e = 0;
     583                                          f = bsearch(&key,
     584                                                      (const uint8_t*) p + le64toh(h->header_size),
     585                                                      le64toh(h->n_items),
     586                                                      le64toh(h->catalog_item_size),
     587                                                      (comparison_fn_t) catalog_compare_func);
     588                                  }
     589                          }
     590                  }
     591          }
     592  
     593          if (!f) {
     594                  zero(key.language);
     595                  f = bsearch(&key,
     596                              (const uint8_t*) p + le64toh(h->header_size),
     597                              le64toh(h->n_items),
     598                              le64toh(h->catalog_item_size),
     599                              (comparison_fn_t) catalog_compare_func);
     600          }
     601  
     602          if (!f)
     603                  return NULL;
     604  
     605          return (const char*) p +
     606                  le64toh(h->header_size) +
     607                  le64toh(h->n_items) * le64toh(h->catalog_item_size) +
     608                  le64toh(f->offset);
     609  }
     610  
     611  int catalog_get(const char *database, sd_id128_t id, char **ret_text) {
     612          int r;
     613  
     614          assert(database);
     615          assert(ret_text);
     616  
     617          _cleanup_close_ int fd = -EBADF;
     618          struct stat st;
     619          void *p;
     620          r = open_mmap(database, &fd, &st, &p);
     621          if (r < 0)
     622                  return r;
     623  
     624          const char *s = find_id(p, id);
     625          if (!s)
     626                  r = -ENOENT;
     627          else
     628                  r = strdup_to(ret_text, s);
     629  
     630          (void) munmap(p, st.st_size);
     631          return r;
     632  }
     633  
     634  static char* find_header(const char *s, const char *header) {
     635  
     636          assert(s);
     637          assert(header);
     638  
     639          for (;;) {
     640                  const char *v;
     641  
     642                  v = startswith(s, header);
     643                  if (v) {
     644                          v += strspn(v, WHITESPACE);
     645                          return strndup(v, strcspn(v, NEWLINE));
     646                  }
     647  
     648                  if (!next_header(&s))
     649                          return NULL;
     650          }
     651  }
     652  
     653  static void dump_catalog_entry(FILE *f, sd_id128_t id, const char *s, bool oneline) {
     654          assert(s);
     655  
     656          if (!f)
     657                  f = stdout;
     658  
     659          if (oneline) {
     660                  _cleanup_free_ char *subject = NULL, *defined_by = NULL;
     661  
     662                  subject = find_header(s, "Subject:");
     663                  defined_by = find_header(s, "Defined-By:");
     664  
     665                  fprintf(f, SD_ID128_FORMAT_STR " %s: %s\n",
     666                          SD_ID128_FORMAT_VAL(id),
     667                          strna(defined_by), strna(subject));
     668          } else
     669                  fprintf(f, "-- " SD_ID128_FORMAT_STR "\n%s\n",
     670                          SD_ID128_FORMAT_VAL(id), s);
     671  }
     672  
     673  int catalog_list(FILE *f, const char *database, bool oneline) {
     674          int r;
     675  
     676          assert(database);
     677  
     678          _cleanup_close_ int fd = -EBADF;
     679          struct stat st;
     680          void *p;
     681          r = open_mmap(database, &fd, &st, &p);
     682          if (r < 0)
     683                  return r;
     684  
     685          const CatalogHeader *h = p;
     686          const CatalogItem *items = (const CatalogItem*) ((const uint8_t*) p + le64toh(h->header_size));
     687  
     688          sd_id128_t last_id;
     689          bool last_id_set = false;
     690          for (size_t n = 0; n < le64toh(h->n_items); n++) {
     691                  const char *s;
     692  
     693                  if (last_id_set && sd_id128_equal(last_id, items[n].id))
     694                          continue;
     695  
     696                  assert_se(s = find_id(p, items[n].id));
     697  
     698                  dump_catalog_entry(f, items[n].id, s, oneline);
     699  
     700                  last_id_set = true;
     701                  last_id = items[n].id;
     702          }
     703  
     704          (void) munmap(p, st.st_size);
     705          return 0;
     706  }

      95          log_debug("Successfully sent AF_UNIX socket via STDOUT.");
