    2241  CONFIGFILE_ITEMS = {item.config_key: item for item in CONFIG_ITEMS if item.config_key}
    2242  
    2243  
    2244  def apply_config(namespace: argparse.Namespace, filename: Union[str, Path, None] = None) -> None:
    2245      if filename is None:
    2246          if namespace.config:
    2247              # Config set by the user, use that.
    2248              filename = namespace.config
    2249              print(f'Using config file: {filename}', file=sys.stderr)
    2250          else:
    2251              # Try to look for a config file then use the first one found.
    2252              for config_dir in DEFAULT_CONFIG_DIRS:
    2253                  filename = Path(config_dir) / DEFAULT_CONFIG_FILE
    2254                  if filename.is_file():
    2255                      # Found a config file, use it.
    2256                      print(f'Using found config file: {filename}', file=sys.stderr)
    2257                      break
    2258              else:
    2259                  # No config file specified or found, nothing to do.
    2260                  return
    2261  
    2262      # Fill in ._groups based on --pcr-public-key=, --pcr-private-key=, and --phases=.
    2263      assert '_groups' not in namespace
    2264      n_pcr_priv = len(namespace.pcr_private_keys or ())
    2265      namespace._groups = list(range(n_pcr_priv))  # pylint: disable=protected-access
    2266  
    2267      cp = configparser.ConfigParser(
    2268          comment_prefixes='#',
    2269          inline_comment_prefixes='#',
    2270          delimiters='=',
    2271          empty_lines_in_values=False,
    2272          interpolation=None,
    2273          strict=False,
    2274      )
    2275      # Do not make keys lowercase
    2276      cp.optionxform = lambda option: option  # type: ignore
    2277  
    2278      # The API is not great.
    2279      read = cp.read(filename)
    2280      if not read:
    2281          raise OSError(f'Failed to read {filename}')
    2282  
    2283      for section_name, section in cp.items():
    2284          idx = section_name.find(':')
    2285          if idx >= 0:
    2286              section_name, group = section_name[: idx + 1], section_name[idx + 1 :]
    2287              if not section_name or not group:
    2288                  raise ValueError('Section name components cannot be empty')
    2289              if ':' in group:
    2290                  raise ValueError('Section name cannot contain more than one ":"')
    2291          else:
    2292              group = None
    2293          for key, value in section.items():
    2294              if item := CONFIGFILE_ITEMS.get(f'{section_name}/{key}'):
    2295                  item.apply_config(namespace, section_name, group, key, value)
    2296              else:

    2363  def finalize_options(opts: argparse.Namespace) -> None:

    2365      # ukify verb --arg --arg --arg

    2393      n_pcr_pub = None if opts.pcr_public_keys is None else len(opts.pcr_public_keys)
    2394      n_pcr_priv = None if opts.pcr_private_keys is None else len(opts.pcr_private_keys)
    2395      n_phase_path_groups = None if opts.phase_path_groups is None else len(opts.phase_path_groups)
    2396      if opts.policy_digest and n_pcr_priv is not None:
    2397          raise ValueError('--pcr-private-key= cannot be specified with --policy-digest')
    2398      if (
    2399          opts.policy_digest

    2401          and (n_pcr_cert is None or n_pcr_cert != 1)

    2403          raise ValueError('--policy-digest requires exactly one --pcr-public-key= or --pcr-certificate=')

    2407          raise ValueError('--pcr-certificate= specifications must match --pcr-private-key=')
    2408      if n_pcr_pub is not None and n_pcr_cert is not None:
    2409          raise ValueError('--pcr-public-key= and --pcr-certificate= cannot be used at the same time')

    2471          opts.signtool = 'pesign'

    2475

    2482          )

    2495      if opts.join_pcrsig and not opts.pcrsig:
    2496          raise ValueError('--join-pcrsig requires --pcrsig')
    2497      if opts.pcrsig and (
    2498          opts.linux
    2499          or opts.initrd
    2500          or opts.profile
    2501          or opts.join_profiles
    2502          or opts.microcode
    2503          or opts.sbat
    2504          or opts.uname
    2505          or opts.os_release
    2506          or opts.cmdline
    2507          or opts.hwids
    2508          or opts.splash

    2513          or opts.pcr_certificates

     200                 "  -x --ephemeral           Run VM with snapshot of the disk or directory\n"
     201                 "  -i --image=FILE|DEVICE   Root file system disk image or device for the VM\n"
     202                 "     --image-format=FORMAT Specify disk image format (raw, qcow2; default: raw)\n"
     203                 "\n%3$sHost Configuration:%4$s\n"
     204                 "     --cpus=CPUS           Configure number of CPUs in guest\n"
     205                 "     --ram=BYTES           Configure guest's RAM size\n"
     206                 "     --kvm=BOOL            Enable use of KVM\n"
     207                 "     --vsock=BOOL          Override autodetection of VSOCK support\n"
     208                 "     --vsock-cid=CID       Specify the CID to use for the guest's VSOCK support\n"
     209                 "     --tpm=BOOL            Enable use of a virtual TPM\n"
     210                 "     --tpm-state=off|auto|PATH\n"
     211                 "                           Where to store TPM state\n"
     212                 "     --linux=PATH          Specify the linux kernel for direct kernel boot\n"
     213                 "     --initrd=PATH         Specify the initrd for direct kernel boot\n"
     214                 "  -n --network-tap         Create a TAP device for networking\n"
     215                 "     --network-user-mode   Use user mode networking\n"
     216                 "     --secure-boot=BOOL    Enable searching for firmware supporting SecureBoot\n"
     217                 "     --firmware=PATH|list  Select firmware definition file (or list available)\n"
     218                 "     --discard-disk=BOOL   Control processing of discard requests\n"
     219                 "  -G --grow-image=BYTES    Grow image file to specified size in bytes\n"
     220                 "\n%3$sExecution:%4$s\n"
     221                 "  -s --smbios11=STRING     Pass an arbitrary SMBIOS Type #11 string to the VM\n"
     222                 "     --notify-ready=BOOL   Wait for ready notification from the VM\n"
     223                 "\n%3$sSystem Identity:%4$s\n"
     224                 "  -M --machine=NAME        Set the machine name for the VM\n"
     225                 "     --uuid=UUID           Set a specific machine UUID for the VM\n"
     226                 "\n%3$sProperties:%4$s\n"
     227                 "  -S --slice=SLICE         Place the VM in the specified slice\n"
     228                 "     --property=NAME=VALUE Set scope unit property\n"
     229                 "     --register=BOOLEAN    Register VM as machine\n"
     230                 "     --keep-unit           Do not register a scope for the machine, reuse\n"
     231                 "                           the service unit vmspawn is running in\n"
     232                 "\n%3$sUser Namespacing:%4$s\n"
     233                 "     --private-users=UIDBASE[:NUIDS]\n"
     234                 "                           Configure the UID/GID range to map into the\n"
     235                 "                           virtiofsd namespace\n"
     236                 "\n%3$sMounts:%4$s\n"
     237                 "     --bind=SOURCE[:TARGET]\n"
     238                 "                           Mount a file or directory from the host into the VM\n"
     239                 "     --bind-ro=SOURCE[:TARGET]\n"
     240                 "                           Mount a file or directory, but read-only\n"
     241                 "     --extra-drive=[FORMAT:]PATH\n"
     242                 "                           Adds an additional disk to the virtual machine\n"
     243                 "                           (FORMAT: raw, qcow2; default: raw)\n"
     244                 "     --bind-user=NAME       Bind user from host to virtual machine\n"
     245                 "     --bind-user-shell=BOOL|PATH\n"
     246                 "                            Configure the shell to use for --bind-user= users\n"
     247                 "     --bind-user-group=GROUP\n"
     248                 "                            Add an auxiliary group to --bind-user= users\n"
     249                 "\n%3$sIntegration:%4$s\n"
     250                 "     --forward-journal=FILE|DIR\n"
     251                 "                           Forward the VM's journal to the host\n"
     252                 "     --pass-ssh-key=BOOL   Create an SSH key to access the VM\n"
     253                 "     --ssh-key-type=TYPE   Choose what type of SSH key to pass\n"
     254                 "\n%3$sInput/Output:%4$s\n"
     255                 "     --console=MODE        Console mode (interactive, native, gui)\n"
     256                 "     --background=COLOR    Set ANSI color for background\n"
     257                 "\n%3$sCredentials:%4$s\n"
     258                 "     --set-credential=ID:VALUE\n"
     259                 "                           Pass a credential with literal value to the VM\n"
     260                 "     --load-credential=ID:PATH\n"
     261                 "                           Load credential for the VM from file or AF_UNIX\n"
     262                 "                           stream socket.\n"
     263                 "\nSee the %2$s for details.\n",
     264                 program_invocation_short_name,
     265                 link,
     266                 ansi_underline(),
     267                 ansi_normal(),
     268                 ansi_highlight(),
     269                 ansi_normal());
     270  
     271          return 0;
     272  }
     273  
     274  static int parse_environment(void) {
     275          const char *e;
     276          int r;
     277  
     278          e = getenv("SYSTEMD_VMSPAWN_NETWORK_MAC");
     279          if (e) {
     280                  r = parse_ether_addr(e, &arg_network_provided_mac);
     281                  if (r < 0)
     282                          return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to parse provided MAC address via environment variable");
     283          }
     284  
     285          return 0;
     286  }
     287  
     288  static int parse_argv(int argc, char *argv[]) {
     289          enum {
     290                  ARG_VERSION = 0x100,
     291                  ARG_NO_PAGER,
     292                  ARG_CPUS,
     293                  ARG_RAM,
     294                  ARG_KVM,
     295                  ARG_VSOCK,
     296                  ARG_VSOCK_CID,
     297                  ARG_TPM,
     298                  ARG_LINUX,
     299                  ARG_INITRD,
     300                  ARG_QEMU_GUI,
     301                  ARG_NETWORK_USER_MODE,
     302                  ARG_UUID,
     303                  ARG_REGISTER,
     304                  ARG_KEEP_UNIT,
     305                  ARG_BIND,
     306                  ARG_BIND_RO,
     307                  ARG_EXTRA_DRIVE,
     308                  ARG_SECURE_BOOT,
     309                  ARG_PRIVATE_USERS,
     310                  ARG_FORWARD_JOURNAL,
     311                  ARG_PASS_SSH_KEY,
     312                  ARG_SSH_KEY_TYPE,
     313                  ARG_SET_CREDENTIAL,
     314                  ARG_LOAD_CREDENTIAL,
     315                  ARG_FIRMWARE,
     316                  ARG_DISCARD_DISK,
     317                  ARG_CONSOLE,
     318                  ARG_BACKGROUND,
     319                  ARG_TPM_STATE,
     320                  ARG_NO_ASK_PASSWORD,
     321                  ARG_PROPERTY,
     322                  ARG_NOTIFY_READY,
     323                  ARG_BIND_USER,
     324                  ARG_BIND_USER_SHELL,
     325                  ARG_BIND_USER_GROUP,
     326                  ARG_SYSTEM,
     327                  ARG_USER,
     328                  ARG_IMAGE_FORMAT,
     329          };
     330  
     331          static const struct option options[] = {
     332                  { "help",              no_argument,       NULL, 'h'                   },
     333                  { "version",           no_argument,       NULL, ARG_VERSION           },
     334                  { "quiet",             no_argument,       NULL, 'q'                   },
     335                  { "no-pager",          no_argument,       NULL, ARG_NO_PAGER          },
     336                  { "image",             required_argument, NULL, 'i'                   },
     337                  { "image-format",      required_argument, NULL, ARG_IMAGE_FORMAT      },
     338                  { "ephemeral",         no_argument,       NULL, 'x'                   },
     339                  { "directory",         required_argument, NULL, 'D'                   },
     340                  { "machine",           required_argument, NULL, 'M'                   },
     341                  { "slice",             required_argument, NULL, 'S'                   },
     342                  { "cpus",              required_argument, NULL, ARG_CPUS              },
     343                  { "qemu-smp",          required_argument, NULL, ARG_CPUS              }, /* Compat alias */
     344                  { "ram",               required_argument, NULL, ARG_RAM               },
     345                  { "qemu-mem",          required_argument, NULL, ARG_RAM               }, /* Compat alias */
     346                  { "kvm",               required_argument, NULL, ARG_KVM               },
     347                  { "qemu-kvm",          required_argument, NULL, ARG_KVM               }, /* Compat alias */
     348                  { "vsock",             required_argument, NULL, ARG_VSOCK             },
     349                  { "qemu-vsock",        required_argument, NULL, ARG_VSOCK             }, /* Compat alias */
     350                  { "vsock-cid",         required_argument, NULL, ARG_VSOCK_CID         },
     351                  { "tpm",               required_argument, NULL, ARG_TPM               },
     352                  { "linux",             required_argument, NULL, ARG_LINUX             },
     353                  { "initrd",            required_argument, NULL, ARG_INITRD            },
     354                  { "console",           required_argument, NULL, ARG_CONSOLE           },
     355                  { "qemu-gui",          no_argument,       NULL, ARG_QEMU_GUI          }, /* compat option */
     356                  { "network-tap",       no_argument,       NULL, 'n'                   },
     357                  { "network-user-mode", no_argument,       NULL, ARG_NETWORK_USER_MODE },
     358                  { "uuid",              required_argument, NULL, ARG_UUID              },
     359                  { "register",          required_argument, NULL, ARG_REGISTER          },
     360                  { "keep-unit",         no_argument,       NULL, ARG_KEEP_UNIT         },
     361                  { "bind",              required_argument, NULL, ARG_BIND              },
     362                  { "bind-ro",           required_argument, NULL, ARG_BIND_RO           },
     363                  { "extra-drive",       required_argument, NULL, ARG_EXTRA_DRIVE       },
     364                  { "secure-boot",       required_argument, NULL, ARG_SECURE_BOOT       },
     365                  { "private-users",     required_argument, NULL, ARG_PRIVATE_USERS     },
     366                  { "forward-journal",   required_argument, NULL, ARG_FORWARD_JOURNAL   },
     367                  { "pass-ssh-key",      required_argument, NULL, ARG_PASS_SSH_KEY      },
     368                  { "ssh-key-type",      required_argument, NULL, ARG_SSH_KEY_TYPE      },
     369                  { "set-credential",    required_argument, NULL, ARG_SET_CREDENTIAL    },
     370                  { "load-credential",   required_argument, NULL, ARG_LOAD_CREDENTIAL   },
     371                  { "firmware",          required_argument, NULL, ARG_FIRMWARE          },
     372                  { "discard-disk",      required_argument, NULL, ARG_DISCARD_DISK      },
     373                  { "background",        required_argument, NULL, ARG_BACKGROUND        },
     374                  { "smbios11",          required_argument, NULL, 's'                   },
     375                  { "grow-image",        required_argument, NULL, 'G'                   },
     376                  { "tpm-state",         required_argument, NULL, ARG_TPM_STATE         },
     377                  { "no-ask-password",   no_argument,       NULL, ARG_NO_ASK_PASSWORD   },
     378                  { "property",          required_argument, NULL, ARG_PROPERTY          },
     379                  { "notify-ready",      required_argument, NULL, ARG_NOTIFY_READY      },
     380                  { "bind-user",         required_argument, NULL, ARG_BIND_USER         },
     381                  { "bind-user-shell",   required_argument, NULL, ARG_BIND_USER_SHELL   },
     382                  { "bind-user-group",   required_argument, NULL, ARG_BIND_USER_GROUP   },
     383                  { "system",            no_argument,       NULL, ARG_SYSTEM            },
     384                  { "user",              no_argument,       NULL, ARG_USER              },
     385                  {}
     386          };
     387  
     388          int c, r;
     389  
     390          assert(argc >= 0);
     391          assert(argv);
     392  
     393          optind = 0;
     394          while ((c = getopt_long(argc, argv, "+hD:i:xM:nqs:G:S:", options, NULL)) >= 0)
     395                  switch (c) {
     396                  case 'h':
     397                          return help();
     398  
     399                  case ARG_VERSION:
     400                          return version();
     401  
     402                  case 'q':
     403                          arg_quiet = true;
     404                          break;
     405  
     406                  case 'D':
     407                          r = parse_path_argument(optarg, /* suppress_root= */ false, &arg_directory);
     408                          if (r < 0)
     409                                  return r;
     410  
     411                          break;
     412  
     413                  case 'i':
     414                          r = parse_path_argument(optarg, /* suppress_root= */ false, &arg_image);
     415                          if (r < 0)
     416                                  return r;
     417  
     418                          break;
     419  
     420                  case ARG_IMAGE_FORMAT:
     421                          arg_image_format = image_format_from_string(optarg);
     422                          if (arg_image_format < 0)
     423                                  return log_error_errno(arg_image_format,
     424                                                         "Invalid image format: %s", optarg);
     425                          break;
     426  
     427                  case 'M':
     428                          if (isempty(optarg))
     429                                  arg_machine = mfree(arg_machine);
     430                          else {
     431                                  if (!hostname_is_valid(optarg, 0))
     432                                          return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL),
     433                                                                 "Invalid machine name: %s", optarg);
     434  
     435                                  r = free_and_strdup(&arg_machine, optarg);
     436                                  if (r < 0)
     437                                          return log_oom();
     438                          }
     439                          break;
     440  
     441                  case 'x':
     442                          arg_ephemeral = true;
     443                          break;
     444  
     445                  case ARG_NO_PAGER:
     446                          arg_pager_flags |= PAGER_DISABLE;
     447                          break;
     448  
     449                  case ARG_CPUS:
     450                          r = free_and_strdup_warn(&arg_cpus, optarg);
     451                          if (r < 0)
     452                                  return r;
     453                          break;
     454  
     455                  case ARG_RAM:
     456                          r = parse_size(optarg, 1024, &arg_ram);
     457                          if (r < 0)
     458                                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to parse --ram=%s: %m", optarg);
     459                          break;
     460  
     461                  case ARG_KVM:
     462                          r = parse_tristate_argument_with_auto("--kvm=", optarg, &arg_kvm);
     463                          if (r < 0)
     464                                  return r;
     465                          break;
     466  
     467                  case ARG_VSOCK:
     468                          r = parse_tristate_argument_with_auto("--vsock=", optarg, &arg_vsock);
     469                          if (r < 0)
     470                                  return r;
     471                          break;
     472  
     473                  case ARG_VSOCK_CID:
     474                          if (isempty(optarg))
     475                                  arg_vsock_cid = VMADDR_CID_ANY;
     476                          else {
     477                                  unsigned cid;
     478  
     479                                  r = vsock_parse_cid(optarg, &cid);
     480                                  if (r < 0)
     481                                          return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to parse --vsock-cid: %s", optarg);
     482                                  if (!VSOCK_CID_IS_REGULAR(cid))
     483                                          return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL), "Specified CID is not regular, refusing: %u", cid);
     484  
     485                                  arg_vsock_cid = cid;
     486                          }
     487                          break;
     488  
     489                  case ARG_TPM:
     490                          r = parse_tristate_argument_with_auto("--tpm=", optarg, &arg_tpm);
     491                          if (r < 0)
     492                                  return r;
     493                          break;
     494  
     495                  case ARG_LINUX:
     496                          r = parse_path_argument(optarg, /* suppress_root= */ false, &arg_linux);
     497                          if (r < 0)
     498                                  return r;
     499                          break;
     500  
     501                  case ARG_INITRD: {
     502                          _cleanup_free_ char *initrd_path = NULL;
     503                          r = parse_path_argument(optarg, /* suppress_root= */ false, &initrd_path);
     504                          if (r < 0)
     505                                  return r;
     506  
     507                          r = strv_consume(&arg_initrds, TAKE_PTR(initrd_path));
     508                          if (r < 0)
     509                                  return log_oom();
     510  
     511                          break;
     512                  }
     513  
     514                  case ARG_CONSOLE:
     515                          arg_console_mode = console_mode_from_string(optarg);
     516                          if (arg_console_mode < 0)
     517                                  return log_error_errno(arg_console_mode, "Failed to parse specified console mode: %s", optarg);
     518  
     519                          break;
     520  
     521                  case ARG_QEMU_GUI:
     522                          arg_console_mode = CONSOLE_GUI;
     523                          break;
     524  
     525                  case 'n':
     526                          arg_network_stack = NETWORK_STACK_TAP;
     527                          break;
     528  
     529                  case ARG_NETWORK_USER_MODE:
     530                          arg_network_stack = NETWORK_STACK_USER;
     531                          break;
     532  
     533                  case ARG_UUID:
     534                          r = id128_from_string_nonzero(optarg, &arg_uuid);
     535                          if (r == -ENXIO)
     536                                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL), "Machine UUID may not be all zeroes.");
     537                          if (r < 0)
     538                                  return log_error_errno(r, "Invalid UUID: %s", optarg);
     539  
     540                          break;
     541  
     542                  case ARG_REGISTER:
     543                          r = parse_boolean_argument("--register=", optarg, &arg_register);
     544                          if (r < 0)
     545                                  return r;
     546  
     547                          break;
     548  
     549                  case ARG_KEEP_UNIT:
     550                          arg_keep_unit = true;
     551                          break;
     552  
     553                  case ARG_BIND:
     554                  case ARG_BIND_RO:
     555                          r = runtime_mount_parse(&arg_runtime_mounts, optarg, c == ARG_BIND_RO);
     556                          if (r < 0)
     557                                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to parse --bind(-ro)= argument %s: %m", optarg);
     558  
     559                          break;
     560  
     561                  case ARG_EXTRA_DRIVE: {
     562                          ImageFormat format = IMAGE_FORMAT_RAW;
     563                          const char *dp = optarg;
     564  
     565                          const char *colon = strchr(dp, ':');
     566                          if (colon) {
     567                                  _cleanup_free_ char *fs = strndup(optarg, colon - optarg);
     568                                  if (!fs)
     569                                          return log_oom();
     570  
     571                                  ImageFormat f = image_format_from_string(fs);
     572                                  if (f < 0)
     573                                          log_debug_errno(f, "Cannot parse '%s' as an image format, assuming it is a part of path, ignoring.", fs);
     574                                  else {
     575                                          format = f;
     576                                          dp = colon + 1;
     577                                  }
     578                          }
     579  
     580                          _cleanup_free_ char *drive_path = NULL;
     581                          r = parse_path_argument(dp, /* suppress_root= */ false, &drive_path);
     582                          if (r < 0)
     583                                  return r;
     584  
     585                          if (!GREEDY_REALLOC(arg_extra_drives.drives, arg_extra_drives.n_drives + 1))
     586                                  return log_oom();
     587  
     588                          arg_extra_drives.drives[arg_extra_drives.n_drives++] = (ExtraDrive) {
     589                                  .path = TAKE_PTR(drive_path),
     590                                  .format = format,
     591                          };
     592  
     593                          break;
     594                  }
     595  
     596                  case ARG_SECURE_BOOT:
     597                          r = parse_tristate_argument_with_auto("--secure-boot=", optarg, &arg_secure_boot);
     598                          if (r < 0)
     599                                  return r;
     600                          break;
     601  
     602                  case ARG_PRIVATE_USERS:
     603                          r = parse_userns_uid_range(optarg, &arg_uid_shift, &arg_uid_range);
     604                          if (r < 0)
     605                                  return r;
     606                          break;
     607  
     608                  case ARG_FORWARD_JOURNAL:
     609                          r = parse_path_argument(optarg, /* suppress_root= */ false, &arg_forward_journal);
     610                          if (r < 0)
     611                                  return r;
     612                          break;
     613  
     614                  case ARG_PASS_SSH_KEY:
     615                          r = parse_boolean_argument("--pass-ssh-key=", optarg, &arg_pass_ssh_key);
     616                          if (r < 0)
     617                                  return r;
     618                          break;
     619  
     620                  case ARG_SSH_KEY_TYPE:
     621                          if (!string_is_safe(optarg))
     622                                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL), "Invalid value for --arg-ssh-key-type=: %s", optarg);
     623  
     624                          r = free_and_strdup_warn(&arg_ssh_key_type, optarg);
     625                          if (r < 0)
     626                                  return r;
     627                          break;
     628  
     629                  case ARG_SET_CREDENTIAL: {
     630                          r = machine_credential_set(&arg_credentials, optarg);
     631                          if (r < 0)
     632                                  return r;
     633                          break;
     634                  }
     635  
     636                  case ARG_LOAD_CREDENTIAL: {
     637                          r = machine_credential_load(&arg_credentials, optarg);
     638                          if (r < 0)
     639                                  return r;
     640  
     641                          break;
     642                  }
     643  
     644                  case ARG_FIRMWARE:
     645                          if (streq(optarg, "list")) {
     646                                  _cleanup_strv_free_ char **l = NULL;
     647  
     648                                  r = list_ovmf_config(&l);
     649                                  if (r < 0)
     650                                          return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to list firmwares: %m");
     651  
     652                                  bool nl = false;
     653                                  fputstrv(stdout, l, "\n", &nl);
     654                                  if (nl)
     655                                          putchar('\n');
     656  
     657                                  return 0;
     658                          }
     659  
     660                          if (!isempty(optarg) && !path_is_absolute(optarg) && !startswith(optarg, "./"))
     661                                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL), "Absolute path or path starting with './' required.");
     662  
     663                          r = parse_path_argument(optarg, /* suppress_root= */ false, &arg_firmware);
     664                          if (r < 0)
     665                                  return r;
     666  
     667                          break;
     668  
     669                  case ARG_DISCARD_DISK:
     670                          r = parse_boolean_argument("--discard-disk=", optarg, &arg_discard_disk);
     671                          if (r < 0)
     672                                  return r;
     673                          break;
     674  
     675                  case ARG_BACKGROUND:
     676                          r = parse_background_argument(optarg, &arg_background);
     677                          if (r < 0)
     678                                  return r;
     679                          break;
     680  
     681                  case 's':
     682                          if (isempty(optarg)) {
     683                                  arg_smbios11 = strv_free(arg_smbios11);
     684                                  break;
     685                          }
     686  
     687                          if (!utf8_is_valid(optarg))
     688                                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL), "SMBIOS Type 11 string is not UTF-8 clean, refusing: %s", optarg);
     689  
     690                          if (strv_extend(&arg_smbios11, optarg) < 0)
     691                                  return log_oom();
     692  
     693                          break;
     694  
     695                  case 'G':
     696                          if (isempty(optarg)) {
     697                                  arg_grow_image = 0;
     698                                  break;
     699                          }
     700  
     701                          r = parse_size(optarg, 1024, &arg_grow_image);
     702                          if (r < 0)
     703                                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to parse --grow-image= parameter: %s", optarg);
     704  
     705                          break;
     706  
     707                  case ARG_TPM_STATE:
     708                          if (path_is_valid(optarg) && (path_is_absolute(optarg) || path_startswith(optarg, "./"))) {
     709                                  r = parse_path_argument(optarg, /* suppress_root= */ false, &arg_tpm_state_path);
     710                                  if (r < 0)
     711                                          return r;
     712  
     713                                  arg_tpm_state_mode = TPM_STATE_PATH;
     714                                  break;
     715                          }
     716  
     717                          r = isempty(optarg) ? false :
     718                                  streq(optarg, "auto") ? true :
     719                                  parse_boolean(optarg);
     720                          if (r < 0)
     721                                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to parse --tpm-state= parameter: %s", optarg);
     722  
     723                          arg_tpm_state_mode = r ? TPM_STATE_AUTO : TPM_STATE_OFF;
     724                          arg_tpm_state_path = mfree(arg_tpm_state_path);
     725                          break;
     726  
     727                  case ARG_NO_ASK_PASSWORD:
     728                          arg_ask_password = false;
     729                          break;
     730  
     731                  case 'S': {
     732                          _cleanup_free_ char *mangled = NULL;
     733  
     734                          r = unit_name_mangle_with_suffix(optarg, /* operation= */ NULL, UNIT_NAME_MANGLE_WARN, ".slice", &mangled);
     735                          if (r < 0)
     736                                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to turn '%s' into unit name: %m", optarg);
     737  
     738                          free_and_replace(arg_slice, mangled);
     739                          break;
     740                  }
     741  
     742                  case ARG_PROPERTY:
     743                          if (strv_extend(&arg_property, optarg) < 0)
     744                                  return log_oom();
     745  
     746                          break;
     747  
     748                  case ARG_NOTIFY_READY:
     749                          r = parse_boolean_argument("--notify-ready=", optarg, &arg_notify_ready);
     750                          if (r < 0)
     751                                  return r;
     752  
     753                          break;
     754  
     755                  case ARG_BIND_USER:
     756                          if (!valid_user_group_name(optarg, /* flags= */ 0))
     757                                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL), "Invalid user name to bind: %s", optarg);
     758  
     759                          if (strv_extend(&arg_bind_user, optarg) < 0)
     760                                  return log_oom();
     761  
     762                          break;
     763  
     764                  case ARG_BIND_USER_SHELL: {
     765                          bool copy = false;
     766                          char *sh = NULL;
     767                          r = parse_user_shell(optarg, &sh, &copy);
     768                          if (r == -ENOMEM)
     769                                  return log_oom();
     770                          if (r < 0)
     771                                  return log_error_errno(r, "Invalid user shell to bind: %s", optarg);
     772  
     773                          free_and_replace(arg_bind_user_shell, sh);
     774                          arg_bind_user_shell_copy = copy;
     775  
     776                          break;
     777                  }
     778  
     779                  case ARG_BIND_USER_GROUP:
     780                          if (!valid_user_group_name(optarg, /* flags= */ 0))
     781                                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL), "Invalid bind user auxiliary group name: %s", optarg);
     782  
     783                          if (strv_extend(&arg_bind_user_groups, optarg) < 0)
     784                                  return log_oom();
     785  
     786                          break;
     787  
     788                  case ARG_SYSTEM:
     789                          arg_runtime_scope = RUNTIME_SCOPE_SYSTEM;
     790                          break;
     791  
     792                  case ARG_USER:
     793                          arg_runtime_scope = RUNTIME_SCOPE_USER;
     794                          break;
     795  
     796                  case '?':
     797                          return -EINVAL;
     798  
     799                  default:
     800                          assert_not_reached();
     801                  }
     802  
     803          /* Drop duplicate --bind-user= and --bind-user-group= entries */
     804          strv_uniq(arg_bind_user);
     805          strv_uniq(arg_bind_user_groups);
     806  
     807          if (arg_bind_user_shell && strv_isempty(arg_bind_user))
     808                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL), "Cannot use --bind-user-shell= without --bind-user=");
     809  
     810          if (!strv_isempty(arg_bind_user_groups) && strv_isempty(arg_bind_user))
     811                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL), "Cannot use --bind-user-group= without --bind-user=");
     812  
     813          if (arg_ephemeral && arg_extra_drives.n_drives > 0)
     814                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL), "Cannot use --ephemeral with --extra-drive=");
     815  
     816          if (arg_uid_shift != UID_INVALID && !arg_directory)
     817                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL), "--private-users= is only supported in combination with --directory=.");
     818  
     819          if (arg_directory && arg_uid_shift == UID_INVALID) {
     820                  struct stat st;
     821                  if (stat(arg_directory, &st) < 0)
     822                          return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to stat '%s': %m", arg_directory);
     823  
     824                  r = stat_verify_directory(&st);
     825                  if (r < 0)
     826                          return log_error_errno(r, "'%s' is not a directory: %m", arg_directory);
     827  
     828                  arg_uid_shift = st.st_uid;
     829                  arg_uid_range = 0x10000;
     830          }
     831  
     832          if (argc > optind) {
     833                  arg_kernel_cmdline_extra = strv_copy(argv + optind);
     834                  if (!arg_kernel_cmdline_extra)
     835                          return log_oom();
     836          }
     837  
     838          return 1;
     839  }
     840  
     841  static int open_vsock(void) {
     842          static const union sockaddr_union bind_addr = {
     843                  .vm.svm_family = AF_VSOCK,
     844                  .vm.svm_cid = VMADDR_CID_ANY,
     845                  .vm.svm_port = VMADDR_PORT_ANY,
     846          };
     847  
     848          _cleanup_close_ int vsock_fd = socket(AF_VSOCK, SOCK_STREAM|SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0);
     849          if (vsock_fd < 0)
     850                  return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to open AF_VSOCK socket: %m");
     851  
     852          if (bind(vsock_fd, &bind_addr.sa, sizeof(bind_addr.vm)) < 0)
     853                  return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to bind to VSOCK address %u:%u: %m", bind_addr.vm.svm_cid, bind_addr.vm.svm_port);
     854  
     855          if (listen(vsock_fd, SOMAXCONN_DELUXE) < 0)
     856                  return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to listen on VSOCK: %m");
     857  
     858          return TAKE_FD(vsock_fd);
     859  }
     860  
     861  typedef struct NotifyConnectionData {
     862          char buffer[NOTIFY_BUFFER_MAX+1];
     863          size_t full;
     864          int *exit_status;
     865  } NotifyConnectionData;
     866  
     867  static int read_vsock_notify(NotifyConnectionData *d, int fd) {
     868          int r;
     869  
     870          assert(d);
     871          assert(fd >= 0);
     872  
     873          for (;;) {
     874                  assert(d->full < sizeof(d->buffer));
     875  
     876                  ssize_t n = read(fd, d->buffer + d->full, sizeof(d->buffer) - d->full);
     877                  if (n < 0) {
     878                          if (ERRNO_IS_TRANSIENT(errno))
     879                                  return 0;
     880  
     881                          return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to read notification message: %m");
     882                  }
     883                  if (n == 0) /* We hit EOF! Let's parse this */
     884                          break;
     885  
     886                  if ((size_t) n >= sizeof(d->buffer) - d->full)
     887                          return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EBADMSG), "Received notify message exceeded maximum size.");
     888  
     889                  d->full += n;
     890          }
     891  
     892          /* We reached EOF, now parse the thing */
     893          assert(d->full < sizeof(d->buffer));
     894          d->buffer[d->full] = 0;
     895  
     896          _cleanup_strv_free_ char **tags = strv_split(d->buffer, "\n\r");
     897          if (!tags)
     898                  return log_oom();
     899  
     900          if (DEBUG_LOGGING) {
     901                  _cleanup_free_ char *j = strv_join(tags, " ");
     902                  log_debug("Received notification message with tags: %s", strnull(j));
     903          }
     904  
     905          const char *status = strv_find_startswith(tags, "STATUS=");
     906          if (status)
     907                  (void) sd_notifyf(/* unset_environment= */ false, "STATUS=VM running: %s", status);
     908  
     909          if (strv_contains(tags, "READY=1")) {
     910                  r = sd_notify(/* unset_environment= */ false, "READY=1");
     911                  if (r < 0)
     912                          log_warning_errno(r, "Failed to send readiness notification, ignoring: %m");
     913  
     914                  if (!status)
     915                          (void) sd_notifyf(/* unset_environment= */ false, "STATUS=VM running.");
     916          }
     917  
     918          const char *p = strv_find_startswith(tags, "EXIT_STATUS=");
     919          if (p) {
     920                  uint8_t k = 0;
     921                  r = safe_atou8(p, &k);
     922                  if (r < 0)
     923                          log_warning_errno(r, "Failed to parse exit status from %s, ignoring: %m", p);
     924                  else
     925                          *d->exit_status = k;
     926          }
     927  
     928          return 1; /* done */
     929  }
     930  
     931  static int vmspawn_dispatch_notify_fd(sd_event_source *source, int fd, uint32_t revents, void *userdata) {
     932          NotifyConnectionData *d = ASSERT_PTR(userdata);
     933          int r;
     934  
     935          assert(source);
     936          assert(fd >= 0);
     937  
     938          r = read_vsock_notify(d, fd);
     939          if (r != 0) {
     940                  int q;
     941  
     942                  /* If we are done or are seeing an error we'll turn off floating mode, which means the event
     943                   * loop itself won't keep the event source pinned anymore, and since no one else (hopefully!)
     944                   * keeps a reference anymore the whole thing will be released once we exit from this handler
     945                   * here. */
     946  
     947                  q = sd_event_source_set_floating(source, false);
     948                  if (q < 0)
     949                          log_warning_errno(q, "Failed to disable floating mode of event source, ignoring: %m");
     950  
     951                  return r;
     952          }
     953  
     954          return 0;
     955  }
     956  
     957  static int vmspawn_dispatch_vsock_connections(sd_event_source *source, int fd, uint32_t revents, void *userdata) {
     958          _cleanup_close_ int conn_fd = -EBADF;
     959          sd_event *event;
     960          int r;
     961  
     962          assert(userdata);
     963  
     964          if (revents != EPOLLIN) {
     965                  log_warning("Got unexpected poll event for VSOCK fd.");
     966                  return 0;
     967          }
     968  
     969          conn_fd = accept4(fd, NULL, NULL, SOCK_CLOEXEC|SOCK_NONBLOCK);
     970          if (conn_fd < 0) {
     971                  if (ERRNO_IS_TRANSIENT(errno))
     972                          return 0;
     973  
     974                  log_warning_errno(errno, "Failed to accept connection from VSOCK connection, ignoring: %m");
     975                  return 0;
     976          }
     977  
     978          event = sd_event_source_get_event(source);
     979          if (!event)
     980                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(ENOENT), "Failed to retrieve event from event source, exiting task");
     981  
     982          _cleanup_free_ NotifyConnectionData *d = new(NotifyConnectionData, 1);
     983          if (!d)
     984                  return log_oom();
     985  
     986          *d = (NotifyConnectionData) {
     987                  .exit_status = userdata,
     988          };
     989  
     990          /* add a new floating task to read from the connection */
     991          _cleanup_(sd_event_source_unrefp) sd_event_source *s = NULL;
     992          r = sd_event_add_io(event, &s, conn_fd, EPOLLIN, vmspawn_dispatch_notify_fd, d);
     993          if (r < 0)
     994                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to allocate notify connection event source: %m");
     995  
     996          r = sd_event_source_set_io_fd_own(s, true);
     997          if (r < 0)
     998                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to pass ownership of notify to event source: %m");
     999          TAKE_FD(conn_fd); /* conn_fd is now owned by the event loop so don't clean it up */
    1000  
    1001          r = sd_event_source_set_destroy_callback(s, free);
    1002          if (r < 0)
    1003                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to set destroy callback on event source: %m");
    1004          TAKE_PTR(d); /* The data object will now automatically be freed by the event source when it goes away */
    1005  
    1006          /* Finally, make sure the event loop pins the event source */
    1007          r = sd_event_source_set_floating(s, true);
    1008          if (r < 0)
    1009                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to set event source to floating mode: %m");
    1010  
    1011          (void) sd_event_source_set_description(s, "vmspawn-notify-socket-connection");
    1012  
    1013          return 0;
    1014  }
    1015  
    1016  static int setup_notify_parent(sd_event *event, int fd, int *exit_status, sd_event_source **ret_notify_event_source) {
    1017          int r;
    1018  
    1019          assert(event);
    1020          assert(fd >= 0);
    1021          assert(exit_status);
    1022          assert(ret_notify_event_source);
    1023  
    1024          r = sd_event_add_io(event, ret_notify_event_source, fd, EPOLLIN, vmspawn_dispatch_vsock_connections, exit_status);
    1025          if (r < 0)
    1026                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to allocate notify socket event source: %m");
    1027  
    1028          (void) sd_event_source_set_description(*ret_notify_event_source, "vmspawn-notify-socket-listen");
    1029  
    1030          return 0;
    1031  }
    1032  
    1033  static int bus_open_in_machine(sd_bus **ret, unsigned cid, unsigned port, const char *private_key_path) {
    1034          _cleanup_(sd_bus_flush_close_unrefp) sd_bus *bus = NULL;
    1035          _cleanup_free_ char *ssh_escaped = NULL, *bus_address = NULL;
    1036          char port_str[DECIMAL_STR_MAX(unsigned)], cid_str[DECIMAL_STR_MAX(unsigned)];
    1037          int r;
    1038  
    1039          assert(ret);
    1040          assert(private_key_path);
    1041  
    1042          r = sd_bus_new(&bus);
    1043          if (r < 0)
    1044                  return r;
    1045  
    1046          const char *ssh = secure_getenv("SYSTEMD_SSH") ?: "ssh";
    1047          ssh_escaped = bus_address_escape(ssh);
    1048          if (!ssh_escaped)
    1049                  return -ENOMEM;
    1050  
    1051          xsprintf(port_str, "%u", port);
    1052          xsprintf(cid_str, "%u", cid);
    1053  
    1054          bus_address = strjoin(
    1055                  "unixexec:path=", ssh_escaped,
    1056                  /* -x: Disable X11 forwarding
    1057                   * -T: Disable PTY allocation */
    1058                  ",argv1=-xT",
    1059                  ",argv2=-o,argv3=IdentitiesOnly yes",
    1060                  ",argv4=-o,argv5=IdentityFile=", private_key_path,
    1061                  ",argv6=-p,argv7=", port_str,
    1062                  ",argv8=--",
    1063                  ",argv9=root@vsock/", cid_str,
    1064                  ",argv10=systemd-stdio-bridge"
    1065          );
    1066          if (!bus_address)
    1067                  return -ENOMEM;
    1068  
    1069          free_and_replace(bus->address, bus_address);
    1070          bus->bus_client = true;
    1071          bus->trusted = true;
    1072          bus->runtime_scope = RUNTIME_SCOPE_SYSTEM;
    1073          bus->is_local = false;
    1074  
    1075          r = sd_bus_start(bus);
    1076          if (r < 0)
    1077                  return r;
    1078  
    1079          *ret = TAKE_PTR(bus);
    1080          return 0;
    1081  }
    1082  
    1083  static int shutdown_vm_graceful(sd_event_source *s, const struct signalfd_siginfo *si, void *userdata) {
    1084          _cleanup_(sd_bus_flush_close_unrefp) sd_bus *bus = NULL;
    1085          _cleanup_(sd_bus_error_free) sd_bus_error error = SD_BUS_ERROR_NULL;
    1086          ShutdownInfo *shutdown_info = ASSERT_PTR(userdata);
    1087          SSHInfo *ssh_info = ASSERT_PTR(shutdown_info->ssh_info);
    1088          int r;
    1089  
    1090          assert(s);
    1091          assert(si);
    1092  
    1093          /* If we don't have the vsock address and the SSH key, go to fallback */
    1094          if (ssh_info->cid == VMADDR_CID_ANY || !ssh_info->private_key_path)
    1095                  goto fallback;
    1096  
    1097          /*
    1098           * In order we should try:
    1099           * 1. PowerOff from logind respects inhibitors but might not be available
    1100           * 2. PowerOff from systemd heavy handed but should always be available
    1101           * 3. SIGKILL qemu (this waits for qemu to die still)
    1102           * 4. kill ourselves by shutting down our event loop (this does not wait for qemu)
    1103           */
    1104  
    1105          r = bus_open_in_machine(&bus, ssh_info->cid, ssh_info->port, ssh_info->private_key_path);
    1106          if (r < 0) {
    1107                  log_warning_errno(r, "Failed to connect to VM to forward signal, ignoring: %m");
    1108                  goto fallback;
    1109          }
    1110  
    1111          r = bus_call_method(bus, bus_login_mgr, "PowerOff", &error, /* ret_reply= */ NULL, "b", false);
    1112          if (r >= 0) {
    1113                  log_info("Requested powering off VM through D-Bus.");
    1114                  return 0;
    1115          }
    1116  
    1117          log_warning_errno(r, "Failed to shutdown VM via logind, ignoring: %s", bus_error_message(&error, r));
    1118          sd_bus_error_free(&error);
    1119  
    1120          r = bus_call_method(bus, bus_systemd_mgr, "PowerOff", &error, /* ret_reply= */ NULL, /* types= */ NULL);
    1121          if (r >= 0) {
    1122                  log_info("Requested powering off VM through D-Bus.");
    1123                  return 0;
    1124          }
    1125  
    1126          log_warning_errno(r, "Failed to shutdown VM via systemd, ignoring: %s", bus_error_message(&error, r));
    1127  
    1128  fallback:
    1129          /* at this point SSH clearly isn't working so don't try it again */
    1130          TAKE_STRUCT(*ssh_info);
    1131  
    1132          /* Backup method to shut down the VM when D-BUS access over SSH is not available */
    1133          if (shutdown_info->pidref) {
    1134                  r = pidref_kill(shutdown_info->pidref, SIGKILL);
    1135                  if (r < 0)
    1136                          log_warning_errno(r, "Failed to kill qemu, terminating: %m");
    1137                  else {
    1138                          TAKE_PTR(shutdown_info->pidref);
    1139                          log_info("Trying to halt qemu. Send SIGTERM again to trigger vmspawn to immediately terminate.");
    1140                          return 0;
    1141                  }
    1142          }
    1143  
    1144          return sd_event_exit(sd_event_source_get_event(s), 0);
    1145  }
    1146  
    1147  static int on_child_exit(sd_event_source *s, const siginfo_t *si, void *userdata) {
    1148          assert(si);
    1149  
    1150          /* Let's first do some logging about the exit status of the child. */
    1151  
    1152          int ret;
    1153          if (si->si_code == CLD_EXITED) {
    1154                  if (si->si_status == EXIT_SUCCESS)
    1155                          log_debug("Child process " PID_FMT " exited successfully.", si->si_pid);
    1156                  else
    1157                          log_error("Child process " PID_FMT " died with a failure exit status %i.", si->si_pid, si->si_status);
    1158  
    1159                  ret = si->si_status;
    1160          } else if (si->si_code == CLD_KILLED)
    1161                  ret = log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EPROTO),
    1162                                        "Child process " PID_FMT " was killed by signal %s.",
    1163                                        si->si_pid, signal_to_string(si->si_status));
    1164          else if (si->si_code == CLD_DUMPED)
    1165                  ret = log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EPROTO),
    1166                                        "Child process " PID_FMT " dumped core by signal %s.",
    1167                                        si->si_pid, signal_to_string(si->si_status));
    1168          else
    1169                  ret = log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EPROTO),
    1170                                        "Got unexpected exit code %i from child.",
    1171                                        si->si_code);
    1172  
    1173          /* Regardless of whether the main qemu process or an auxiliary process died, let's exit either way
    1174           * as it's very likely that the main qemu process won't be able to operate properly anymore if one
    1175           * of the auxiliary processes died. */
    1176  
    1177          sd_event_exit(sd_event_source_get_event(s), ret);
    1178          return 0;
    1179  }
    1180  
    1181  static int cmdline_add_vsock(char ***cmdline, int vsock_fd) {
    1182          int r;
    1183  
    1184          r = strv_extend(cmdline, "-smbios");
    1185          if (r < 0)
    1186                  return r;
    1187  
    1188          union sockaddr_union addr;
    1189          socklen_t addr_len = sizeof addr.vm;
    1190          if (getsockname(vsock_fd, &addr.sa, &addr_len) < 0)
    1191                  return -errno;
    1192  
    1193          assert(addr_len >= sizeof addr.vm);
    1194          assert(addr.vm.svm_family == AF_VSOCK);
    1195  
    1196          r = strv_extendf(cmdline, "type=11,value=io.systemd.credential:vmm.notify_socket=vsock-stream:%u:%u", (unsigned) VMADDR_CID_HOST, addr.vm.svm_port);
    1197          if (r < 0)
    1198                  return r;
    1199  
    1200          return 0;
    1201  }
    1202  
    1203  static int cmdline_add_kernel_cmdline(char ***cmdline, const char *kernel, const char *smbios_dir) {
    1204          int r;
    1205  
    1206          assert(cmdline);
    1207  
    1208          if (strv_isempty(arg_kernel_cmdline_extra))
    1209                  return 0;
    1210  
    1211          _cleanup_free_ char *kcl = strv_join(arg_kernel_cmdline_extra, " ");
    1212          if (!kcl)
    1213                  return log_oom();
    1214  
    1215          if (kernel) {
    1216                  if (strv_extend_many(cmdline, "-append", kcl) < 0)
    1217                          return log_oom();
    1218          } else {
    1219                  if (!ARCHITECTURE_SUPPORTS_SMBIOS) {
    1220                          log_warning("Cannot append extra args to kernel cmdline, native architecture doesn't support SMBIOS, ignoring.");
    1221                          return 0;
    1222                  }
    1223  
    1224                  FOREACH_STRING(id, "io.systemd.stub.kernel-cmdline-extra", "io.systemd.boot.kernel-cmdline-extra") {
    1225                          _cleanup_free_ char *p = path_join(smbios_dir, id);
    1226                          if (!p)
    1227                                  return log_oom();
    1228  
    1229                          r = write_string_filef(
    1230                                          p,
    1231                                          WRITE_STRING_FILE_CREATE|WRITE_STRING_FILE_AVOID_NEWLINE|WRITE_STRING_FILE_MODE_0600,
    1232                                          "%s=%s", id, kcl);
    1233                          if (r < 0)
    1234                                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to write smbios kernel command line to file: %m");
    1235  
    1236                          if (strv_extend(cmdline, "-smbios") < 0)
    1237                                  return log_oom();
    1238  
    1239                          if (strv_extend_joined(cmdline, "type=11,path=", p) < 0)
    1240                                  return log_oom();
    1241                  }
    1242          }
    1243  
    1244          return 0;
    1245  }
    1246  
    1247  static int cmdline_add_smbios11(char ***cmdline, const char* smbios_dir) {
    1248          int r;
    1249  
    1250          assert(cmdline);
    1251  
    1252          if (strv_isempty(arg_smbios11))
    1253                  return 0;
    1254  
    1255          if (!ARCHITECTURE_SUPPORTS_SMBIOS) {
    1256                  log_warning("Cannot issue SMBIOS Type #11 strings, native architecture doesn't support SMBIOS, ignoring.");
    1257                  return 0;
    1258          }
    1259  
    1260          STRV_FOREACH(i, arg_smbios11) {
    1261                  _cleanup_(unlink_and_freep) char *p = NULL;
    1262  
    1263                  r = tempfn_random_child(smbios_dir, "smbios11", &p);
    1264                  if (r < 0)
    1265                          return r;
    1266  
    1267                  r = write_string_file(
    1268                                  p, *i,
    1269                                  WRITE_STRING_FILE_CREATE|WRITE_STRING_FILE_AVOID_NEWLINE|WRITE_STRING_FILE_MODE_0600);
    1270                  if (r < 0)
    1271                          return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to write smbios data to smbios file %s: %m", p);
    1272  
    1273                  if (strv_extend(cmdline, "-smbios") < 0)
    1274                          return log_oom();
    1275  
    1276                  if (strv_extend_joined(cmdline, "type=11,path=", p) < 0)
    1277                          return log_oom();
    1278  
    1279                  p = mfree(p);
    1280          }
    1281  
    1282          return 0;
    1283  }
    1284  
    1285  static int start_tpm(
    1286                  const char *scope,
    1287                  const char *swtpm,
    1288                  const char *runtime_dir,
    1289                  const char *sd_socket_activate,
    1290                  char **ret_listen_address,
    1291                  PidRef *ret_pidref) {
    1292  
    1293          int r;
    1294  
    1295          assert(scope);
    1296          assert(swtpm);
    1297          assert(runtime_dir);
    1298  
    1299          _cleanup_free_ char *scope_prefix = NULL;
    1300          r = unit_name_to_prefix(scope, &scope_prefix);
    1301          if (r < 0)
    1302                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to strip .scope suffix from scope: %m");
    1303  
    1304          _cleanup_free_ char *listen_address = path_join(runtime_dir, "tpm.sock");
    1305          if (!listen_address)
    1306                  return log_oom();
    1307  
    1308          _cleanup_free_ char *transient_state_dir = NULL;
    1309          const char *state_dir;
    1310          if (arg_tpm_state_path)
    1311                  state_dir = arg_tpm_state_path;
    1312          else {
    1313                  _cleanup_free_ char *dirname = strjoin(scope_prefix, "-tpm");
    1314                  if (!dirname)
    1315                          return log_oom();
    1316  
    1317                  transient_state_dir = path_join(runtime_dir, dirname);
    1318                  if (!transient_state_dir)
    1319                          return log_oom();
    1320  
    1321                  state_dir = transient_state_dir;
    1322          }
    1323  
    1324          r = mkdir_p(state_dir, 0700);
    1325          if (r < 0)
    1326                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to create TPM state directory '%s': %m", state_dir);
    1327  
    1328          _cleanup_free_ char *swtpm_setup = NULL;
    1329          r = find_executable("swtpm_setup", &swtpm_setup);
    1330          if (r < 0)
    1331                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to find swtpm_setup binary: %m");
    1332  
    1333          /* Try passing --profile-name default-v2 first, in order to support RSA4096 pcrsig keys, which was
    1334           * added in 0.11. */
    1335          _cleanup_strv_free_ char **argv = strv_new(
    1336                          swtpm_setup,
    1337                          "--tpm-state", state_dir,
    1338                          "--tpm2",
    1339                          "--pcr-banks", "sha256",
    1340                          "--not-overwrite",
    1341                          "--profile-name", "default-v2");
    1342          if (!argv)
    1343                  return log_oom();
    1344  
    1345          r = pidref_safe_fork("(swtpm-setup)", FORK_CLOSE_ALL_FDS|FORK_LOG|FORK_WAIT, /* ret= */ NULL);
    1346          if (r == 0) {
    1347                  /* Child */
    1348                  execvp(argv[0], argv);
    1349                  log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to execute '%s': %m", argv[0]);
    1350                  _exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    1351          }
    1352          if (r == -EPROTO) {
    1353                  /* If swtpm_setup fails, try again removing the default-v2 profile, as it might be an older
    1354                   * version. */
    1355                  strv_remove(argv, "--profile-name");
    1356                  strv_remove(argv, "default-v2");
    1357  
    1358                  r = pidref_safe_fork("(swtpm-setup)", FORK_CLOSE_ALL_FDS|FORK_LOG|FORK_WAIT, /* ret= */ NULL);
    1359                  if (r == 0) {
    1360                          /* Child */
    1361                          execvp(argv[0], argv);
    1362                          log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to execute '%s': %m", argv[0]);
    1363                          _exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    1364                  }
    1365          }
    1366          if (r < 0)
    1367                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to run swtpm_setup: %m");
    1368  
    1369          strv_free(argv);
    1370          argv = strv_new(sd_socket_activate, "--listen", listen_address, swtpm, "socket", "--tpm2", "--tpmstate");
    1371          if (!argv)
    1372                  return log_oom();
    1373  
    1374          r = strv_extend_joined(&argv, "dir=", state_dir);
    1375          if (r < 0)
    1376                  return log_oom();
    1377  
    1378          r = strv_extend_many(&argv, "--ctrl", "type=unixio,fd=3");
    1379          if (r < 0)
    1380                  return log_oom();
    1381  
    1382          r = fork_notify(argv, ret_pidref);
    1383          if (r < 0)
    1384                  return r;
    1385  
    1386          if (ret_listen_address)
    1387                  *ret_listen_address = TAKE_PTR(listen_address);
    1388  
    1389          return 0;
    1390  }

    1392  static int start_systemd_journal_remote(

    1397                  PidRef *ret_pidref) {

    1402

    1418                                                          * LIBEXECDIR, but for supporting fancy setups. */
    1419                          &sd_journal_remote,

    1421          if (r < 0)
