    1443  static int discover_root(char **ret) {
    1444          int r;
    1445          _cleanup_(dissected_image_unrefp) DissectedImage *image = NULL;
    1446          _cleanup_free_ char *root = NULL;
    1447  
    1448          assert(ret);
    1449  
    1450          r = dissect_image_file_and_warn(
    1451                          arg_image,
    1452                          /* verity= */ NULL,
    1453                          /* mount_options= */ NULL,
    1454                          /* image_policy= */ NULL,
    1455                          /* image_filter= */ NULL,
    1456                          /* flags= */ 0,
    1457                          &image);
    1458          if (r < 0)
    1459                  return r;
    1460  
    1461          if (image->partitions[PARTITION_ROOT].found)
    1462                  root = strjoin("root=PARTUUID=", SD_ID128_TO_UUID_STRING(image->partitions[PARTITION_ROOT].uuid));
    1463          else if (image->partitions[PARTITION_USR].found)
    1464                  root = strjoin("mount.usr=PARTUUID=", SD_ID128_TO_UUID_STRING(image->partitions[PARTITION_USR].uuid));
    1465          else
    1466                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(ENOENT), "Cannot perform a direct kernel boot without a root or usr partition, refusing");
    1467  
    1468          if (!root)
    1469                  return log_oom();
    1470  
    1471          *ret = TAKE_PTR(root);
    1472          return 0;
    1473  }
    1474  
    1475  static int find_virtiofsd(char **ret) {
    1476          int r;
    1477          _cleanup_free_ char *virtiofsd = NULL;
    1478  
    1479          assert(ret);
    1480  
    1481          r = find_executable("virtiofsd", &virtiofsd);
    1482          if (r < 0 && r != -ENOENT)
    1483                  return log_error_errno(r, "Error while searching for virtiofsd: %m");
    1484  
    1485          if (!virtiofsd) {
    1486                  FOREACH_STRING(file, "/usr/libexec/virtiofsd", "/usr/lib/virtiofsd") {
    1487                          if (access(file, X_OK) >= 0) {
    1488                                  virtiofsd = strdup(file);
    1489                                  if (!virtiofsd)
    1490                                          return log_oom();
    1491                                  break;
    1492                          }
    1493  
    1494                          if (!IN_SET(errno, ENOENT, EACCES))
    1495                                  return log_error_errno(errno, "Error while searching for virtiofsd: %m");
    1496                  }
    1497          }
    1498  
    1499          if (!virtiofsd)
    1500                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(ENOENT), "Failed to find virtiofsd binary.");
    1501  
    1502          *ret = TAKE_PTR(virtiofsd);
    1503          return 0;
    1504  }
    1505  
    1506  static int start_virtiofsd(
    1507                  const char *scope,
    1508                  const char *directory,
    1509                  uid_t source_uid,
    1510                  uid_t target_uid,
    1511                  uid_t uid_range,
    1512                  const char *runtime_dir,
    1513                  char **ret_listen_address,
    1514                  PidRef *ret_pidref) {
    1515  
    1516          int r;
    1517  
    1518          assert(scope);
    1519          assert(directory);
    1520          assert(runtime_dir);
    1521  
    1522          _cleanup_free_ char *virtiofsd = NULL;
    1523          r = find_virtiofsd(&virtiofsd);
    1524          if (r < 0)
    1525                  return r;
    1526  
    1527          _cleanup_free_ char *scope_prefix = NULL;
    1528          r = unit_name_to_prefix(scope, &scope_prefix);
    1529          if (r < 0)
    1530                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to strip .scope suffix from scope: %m");
    1531  
    1532          _cleanup_free_ char *listen_address = NULL;
    1533          if (asprintf(&listen_address, "%s/sock-%"PRIx64, runtime_dir, random_u64()) < 0)
    1534                  return log_oom();
    1535  
    1536          union sockaddr_union su;
    1537          r = sockaddr_un_set_path(&su.un, listen_address);
    1538          if (r < 0)
    1539                  return r;
    1540  
    1541          _cleanup_close_ int sock = socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM|SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0);
    1542          if (sock < 0)
    1543                  return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to create unix socket: %m");
    1544  
    1545          if (bind(sock, &su.sa, r) < 0)
    1546                  return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to bind unix socket to '%s': %m", listen_address);
    1547  
    1548          if (listen(sock, SOMAXCONN_DELUXE) < 0)
    1549                  return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to listen on unix socket '%s': %m", listen_address);
    1550  
    1551          _cleanup_free_ char *sockstr = NULL;
    1552          if (asprintf(&sockstr, "%i", sock) < 0)
    1553                  return log_oom();
    1554  
    1555          /* QEMU doesn't support submounts so don't announce them */
    1556          _cleanup_strv_free_ char **argv = strv_new(
    1557                          virtiofsd,
    1558                          "--shared-dir", source_uid == FOREIGN_UID_MIN ? "/run/systemd/mount-rootfs" : directory,
    1559                          "--xattr",
    1560                          "--fd", sockstr,
    1561                          "--sandbox=chroot",
    1562                          "--no-announce-submounts");
    1563          if (!argv)
    1564                  return log_oom();
    1565  
    1566          _cleanup_close_ int userns_fd = -EBADF, mapped_fd = -EBADF;
    1567  
    1568          if (source_uid == FOREIGN_UID_MIN) {
    1569                  assert(target_uid == 0);
    1570                  assert(uid_range == 0x10000);
    1571  
    1572                  userns_fd = nsresource_allocate_userns(/* vl= */ NULL, /* name= */ NULL, NSRESOURCE_UIDS_64K);
    1573                  if (userns_fd < 0)
    1574                          return log_error_errno(userns_fd, "Failed to allocate user namespace for virtiofsd: %m");
    1575  
    1576                  _cleanup_close_ int directory_fd = open(directory, O_DIRECTORY|O_CLOEXEC|O_PATH);
    1577                  if (directory_fd < 0)
    1578                          return log_error_errno(directory_fd, "Failed to open '%s': %m", directory);
    1579  
    1580                  r = mountfsd_mount_directory_fd(/* vl= */ NULL, directory_fd, userns_fd, DISSECT_IMAGE_FOREIGN_UID, &mapped_fd);
    1581                  if (r < 0)
    1582                          return r;
    1583  
    1584          } else if (!IN_SET(source_uid, FOREIGN_UID_MIN, UID_INVALID) && target_uid != UID_INVALID && uid_range != UID_INVALID) {
    1585                  r = strv_extend(&argv, "--translate-uid");
    1586                  if (r < 0)
    1587                          return log_oom();
    1588  
    1589                  r = strv_extendf(&argv, "map:" UID_FMT ":" UID_FMT ":" UID_FMT, target_uid, source_uid, uid_range);
    1590                  if (r < 0)
    1591                          return log_oom();
    1592  
    1593                  r = strv_extend(&argv, "--translate-gid");
    1594                  if (r < 0)
    1595                          return log_oom();
    1596  
    1597                  r = strv_extendf(&argv, "map:" GID_FMT ":" GID_FMT ":" GID_FMT, target_uid, source_uid, uid_range);
    1598                  if (r < 0)
    1599                          return log_oom();
    1600          }
    1601  
    1602          r = pidref_safe_fork_full(
    1603                          "(virtiofsd)",
    1604                          (const int[3]) { -EBADF, STDOUT_FILENO, STDERR_FILENO },
    1605                          (int[]) { sock, userns_fd, mapped_fd },
    1606                          source_uid == FOREIGN_UID_MIN ? 3 : 1,
    1607                          FORK_RESET_SIGNALS|FORK_DEATHSIG_SIGTERM|FORK_CLOSE_ALL_FDS|FORK_REOPEN_LOG|FORK_REARRANGE_STDIO,
    1608                          ret_pidref);
    1609          if (r < 0)
    1610                  return r;
    1611          if (r == 0) {
    1612                  /* Child */
    1613  
    1614                  r = namespace_enter(
    1615                                  /* pidns_fd= */ -EBADF,
    1616                                  /* mntns_fd= */ -EBADF,
    1617                                  /* netns_fd= */ -EBADF,
    1618                                  userns_fd,
    1619                                  /* root_fd= */ -EBADF);
    1620                  if (r < 0) {
    1621                          log_error_errno(r, "Failed to enter user namespace for virtiofsd: %m");
    1622                          _exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    1623                  }
    1624  
    1625                  if (userns_fd >= 0 && unshare(CLONE_NEWNS) < 0) {
    1626                          log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to unshare mount namespace %m");
    1627                          _exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    1628                  }
    1629  
    1630                  if (mapped_fd >= 0 && move_mount(mapped_fd, "", AT_FDCWD, "/run/systemd/mount-rootfs", MOVE_MOUNT_F_EMPTY_PATH) < 0) {
    1631                          log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to move mount file descriptor to '/run/systemd/mount-rootfs': %m");
    1632                          _exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    1633                  }
    1634  
    1635                  r = fd_cloexec(sock, false);
    1636                  if (r < 0) {
    1637                          log_error_errno(r, "Failed to disable cloexec on socket: %m");
    1638                          _exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    1639                  }
    1640  
    1641                  invoke_callout_binary(argv[0], argv);
    1642                  log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to execute '%s': %m", argv[0]);
    1643                  _exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    1644          }
    1645  
    1646          if (ret_listen_address)
    1647                  *ret_listen_address = TAKE_PTR(listen_address);
    1648  
    1649          return 0;
    1650  }
    1651  
    1652  static int bind_user_setup(
    1653                  const MachineBindUserContext *context,
    1654                  MachineCredentialContext *credentials,
    1655                  RuntimeMountContext *mounts) {
    1656  
    1657          int r;
    1658  
    1659          assert(credentials);
    1660          assert(mounts);
    1661  
    1662          if (!context)
    1663                  return 0;
    1664  
    1665          FOREACH_ARRAY(bind_user, context->data, context->n_data) {
    1666                  _cleanup_free_ char *formatted = NULL;
    1667                  r = sd_json_variant_format(bind_user->payload_user->json, SD_JSON_FORMAT_NEWLINE, &formatted);
    1668                  if (r < 0)
    1669                          return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to format JSON user record: %m");
    1670  
    1671                  _cleanup_free_ char *cred = strjoin("userdb.transient.user.", bind_user->payload_user->user_name);
    1672                  if (!cred)
    1673                          return log_oom();
    1674  
    1675                  r = machine_credential_add(credentials, cred, formatted, SIZE_MAX);
    1676                  if (r < 0)
    1677                          return r;
    1678  
    1679                  formatted = mfree(formatted);
    1680                  r = sd_json_variant_format(bind_user->payload_group->json, SD_JSON_FORMAT_NEWLINE, &formatted);
    1681                  if (r < 0)
    1682                          return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to format JSON group record: %m");
    1683  
    1684                  free(cred);
    1685                  cred = strjoin("userdb.transient.group.", bind_user->payload_group->group_name);
    1686                  if (!cred)
    1687                          return log_oom();
    1688  
    1689                  r = machine_credential_add(credentials, cred, formatted, SIZE_MAX);
    1690                  if (r < 0)
    1691                          return r;
    1692  
    1693                  _cleanup_(runtime_mount_done) RuntimeMount mount = {
    1694                          .source = strdup(user_record_home_directory(bind_user->host_user)),
    1695                          .source_uid = bind_user->host_user->uid,
    1696                          .target = strdup(user_record_home_directory(bind_user->payload_user)),
    1697                          .target_uid = bind_user->payload_user->uid,
    1698                  };
    1699                  if (!mount.source || !mount.target)
    1700                          return log_oom();
    1701  
    1702                  if (!GREEDY_REALLOC(mounts->mounts, mounts->n_mounts + 1))
    1703                          return log_oom();
    1704  
    1705                  mounts->mounts[mounts->n_mounts++] = TAKE_STRUCT(mount);
    1706          }
    1707  
    1708          return 0;
    1709  }
    1710  
    1711  static int kernel_cmdline_maybe_append_root(void) {
    1712          int r;
    1713          bool cmdline_contains_root = strv_find_startswith(arg_kernel_cmdline_extra, "root=")
    1714                          || strv_find_startswith(arg_kernel_cmdline_extra, "mount.usr=");
    1715  
    1716          if (!cmdline_contains_root) {
    1717                  _cleanup_free_ char *root = NULL;
    1718  
    1719                  r = discover_root(&root);
    1720                  if (r < 0)
    1721                          return r;
    1722  
    1723                  log_debug("Determined root file system %s from dissected image", root);
    1724  
    1725                  r = strv_consume(&arg_kernel_cmdline_extra, TAKE_PTR(root));
    1726                  if (r < 0)
    1727                          return log_oom();
    1728          }
    1729  
    1730          return 0;
    1731  }
    1732  
    1733  static int discover_boot_entry(const char *root, char **ret_linux, char ***ret_initrds) {
    1734          _cleanup_(boot_config_free) BootConfig config = BOOT_CONFIG_NULL;
    1735          _cleanup_free_ char *esp_path = NULL, *xbootldr_path = NULL;
    1736          int r;
    1737  
    1738          assert(root);
    1739          assert(ret_linux);
    1740          assert(ret_initrds);
    1741  
    1742          esp_path = path_join(root, "efi");
    1743          if (!esp_path)
    1744                  return log_oom();
    1745  
    1746          xbootldr_path = path_join(root, "boot");
    1747          if (!xbootldr_path)
    1748                  return log_oom();
    1749  
    1750          r = boot_config_load(&config, esp_path, xbootldr_path);
    1751          if (r < 0)
    1752                  return r;
    1753  
    1754          r = boot_config_select_special_entries(&config, /* skip_efivars= */ true);
    1755          if (r < 0)
    1756                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to find special boot config entries: %m");
    1757  
    1758          const BootEntry *boot_entry = boot_config_default_entry(&config);
    1759  
    1760          if (boot_entry && !IN_SET(boot_entry->type, BOOT_ENTRY_TYPE1, BOOT_ENTRY_TYPE2))
    1761                  boot_entry = NULL;
    1762  
    1763          /* If we cannot determine a default entry search for UKIs (Type #2 EFI Unified Kernel Images)
    1764           * then .conf files (Type #1 Boot Loader Specification Entries).
    1765           * https://uapi-group.org/specifications/specs/boot_loader_specification */
    1766          if (!boot_entry)
    1767                  FOREACH_ARRAY(entry, config.entries, config.n_entries)
    1768                          if (entry->type == BOOT_ENTRY_TYPE2) { /* UKI */
    1769                                  boot_entry = entry;
    1770                                  break;
    1771                          }
    1772  
    1773          if (!boot_entry)
    1774                  FOREACH_ARRAY(entry, config.entries, config.n_entries)
    1775                          if (entry->type == BOOT_ENTRY_TYPE1) { /* .conf */
    1776                                  boot_entry = entry;
    1777                                  break;
    1778                          }
    1779  
    1780          if (!boot_entry)
    1781                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(ENOENT), "Failed to discover any boot entries.");
    1782  
    1783          log_debug("Discovered boot entry %s (%s)", boot_entry->id, boot_entry_type_description_to_string(boot_entry->type));
    1784  
    1785          _cleanup_free_ char *linux_kernel = NULL;
    1786          _cleanup_strv_free_ char **initrds = NULL;
    1787          if (boot_entry->type == BOOT_ENTRY_TYPE2) { /* UKI */
    1788                  linux_kernel = path_join(boot_entry->root, boot_entry->kernel);
    1789                  if (!linux_kernel)

    1793                  if (!linux_kernel)
    1794                          return log_oom();
    1795  
    1796                  STRV_FOREACH(initrd, boot_entry->initrd) {
    1797                          _cleanup_free_ char *initrd_path = path_join(boot_entry->root, *initrd);
    1798                          if (!initrd_path)
    1799                                  return log_oom();
    1800  
    1801                          r = strv_consume(&initrds, TAKE_PTR(initrd_path));
    1802                          if (r < 0)
    1803                                  return log_oom();
    1804                  }
    1805          } else
    1806                  assert_not_reached();
    1807  
    1808          *ret_linux = TAKE_PTR(linux_kernel);
    1809          *ret_initrds = TAKE_PTR(initrds);

    1813  
    1814  static int merge_initrds(char **ret) {
    1815          _cleanup_(rm_rf_physical_and_freep) char *merged_initrd = NULL;
    1816          _cleanup_close_ int ofd = -EBADF;
    1817          int r;
    1818  
    1819          assert(ret);
    1820  
    1821          r = tempfn_random_child(NULL, "vmspawn-initrd-", &merged_initrd);
    1822          if (r < 0)
    1823                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to create temporary file: %m");
    1824  
    1825          ofd = open(merged_initrd, O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_CLOEXEC, 0600);
    1826          if (ofd < 0)
    1827                  return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to create regular file %s: %m", merged_initrd);
    1828  
    1829          STRV_FOREACH(i, arg_initrds) {
    1830                  _cleanup_close_ int ifd = -EBADF;
    1831                  off_t off, to_seek;
    1832  
    1833                  off = lseek(ofd, 0, SEEK_CUR);
    1834                  if (off < 0)
    1835                          return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to get file offset of %s: %m", merged_initrd);
    1836  
    1837                  to_seek = (4 - (off % 4)) % 4;
    1838  
    1839                  /* seek to assure 4 byte alignment for each initrd */
    1840                  if (to_seek != 0 && lseek(ofd, to_seek, SEEK_CUR) < 0)
    1841                          return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to seek %s: %m", merged_initrd);
    1842  
    1843                  ifd = open(*i, O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC);
    1844                  if (ifd < 0)
    1845                          return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to open %s: %m", *i);
    1846  
    1847                  r = copy_bytes(ifd, ofd, UINT64_MAX, COPY_REFLINK);
    1848                  if (r < 0)
    1849                          return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to copy bytes from %s to %s: %m", *i, merged_initrd);
    1850          }
    1851  
    1852          *ret = TAKE_PTR(merged_initrd);
    1853          return 0;
    1854  }

    1856  static int generate_ssh_keypair(const char *key_path, const char *key_type) {
    1857          _cleanup_free_ char *ssh_keygen = NULL;
    1858          _cleanup_strv_free_ char **cmdline = NULL;
    1859          int r;
    1860  
    1861          assert(key_path);
    1862  
    1863          r = find_executable("ssh-keygen", &ssh_keygen);
    1864          if (r < 0)
    1865                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to find ssh-keygen: %m");
    1866  
    1867          cmdline = strv_new(ssh_keygen, "-f", key_path, /* don't encrypt the key */ "-N", "");
    1868          if (!cmdline)
    1869                  return log_oom();
    1870  
    1871          if (key_type) {
    1872                  r = strv_extend_many(&cmdline, "-t", key_type);
    1873                  if (r < 0)
    1874                          return log_oom();
    1875          }
    1876  
    1877          if (DEBUG_LOGGING) {
    1878                  _cleanup_free_ char *joined = quote_command_line(cmdline, SHELL_ESCAPE_EMPTY);
    1879                  if (!joined)
    1880                          return log_oom();
    1881  
    1882                  log_debug("Executing: %s", joined);
    1883          }
    1884  
    1885          r = pidref_safe_fork_full(
    1886                          ssh_keygen,
    1887                          (int[]) { -EBADF, -EBADF, STDERR_FILENO },
    1888                          /* except_fds= */ NULL, /* n_except_fds= */ 0,
    1889                          FORK_WAIT|FORK_RESET_SIGNALS|FORK_CLOSE_ALL_FDS|FORK_DEATHSIG_SIGTERM|FORK_LOG|FORK_RLIMIT_NOFILE_SAFE|FORK_REARRANGE_STDIO|FORK_REOPEN_LOG,
    1890                          /* ret= */ NULL);
    1891          if (r < 0)
    1892                  return r;
    1893          if (r == 0) {
    1894                  execv(ssh_keygen, cmdline);
    1895                  log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to execve %s: %m", ssh_keygen);
    1896                  _exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    1897          }
    1898  
    1899          return 0;
    1900  }
    1901  
    1902  static int grow_image(const char *path, uint64_t size) {
    1903          int r;
    1904  
    1905          assert(path);
    1906  
    1907          if (size == 0)
    1908                  return 0;
    1909  
    1910          /* Round up to multiple of 4K */
    1911          size = DIV_ROUND_UP(size, 4096);
    1912          if (size > UINT64_MAX / 4096)
    1913                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL), "Specified file size too large, refusing.");
    1914          size *= 4096;
    1915  
    1916          _cleanup_close_ int fd = xopenat_full(AT_FDCWD, path, O_RDWR|O_CLOEXEC, XO_REGULAR, /* mode= */ 0);
    1917          if (fd < 0)
    1918                  return log_error_errno(fd, "Failed to open image file '%s': %m", path);
    1919  
    1920          struct stat st;
    1921          if (fstat(fd, &st) < 0)
    1922                  return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to stat '%s': %m", path);
    1923          if ((uint64_t) st.st_size >= size) {
    1924                  log_debug("Not growing image '%s' to %s, size already at %s.", path,
    1925                            FORMAT_BYTES(size), FORMAT_BYTES(st.st_size));
    1926                  return 0;
    1927          }
    1928  
    1929          if (ftruncate(fd, size) < 0)
    1930                  return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to grow image file '%s' from %s to %s: %m", path,
    1931                                         FORMAT_BYTES(st.st_size), FORMAT_BYTES(size));
    1932  
    1933          r = fsync_full(fd);
    1934          if (r < 0)
    1935                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to sync image file '%s' after growing to %s: %m", path, FORMAT_BYTES(size));
    1936  
    1937          if (!arg_quiet)
    1938                  log_info("Image file '%s' successfully grown from %s to %s.", path, FORMAT_BYTES(st.st_size), FORMAT_BYTES(size));
    1939  
    1940          return 1;
    1941  }

    1948  
    1949          return 0;
    1950  }

    3150  static int determine_names(void) {
    3151          int r;

    3153          if (!arg_directory && !arg_image) {

    3159                                         IMAGE_MACHINE,
    3160                                         arg_machine,
    3161                                         /* root= */ NULL,
    3162                                         &i);
    3163                          if (r == -ENOENT)
    3164                                  return log_error_errno(r, "No image for machine '%s'.", arg_machine);
    3165                          if (r < 0)
    3166                                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to find image for machine '%s': %m", arg_machine);
    3167  
    3168                          if (IN_SET(i->type, IMAGE_RAW, IMAGE_BLOCK))
    3169                                  r = free_and_strdup(&arg_image, i->path);
    3170                          else if (IN_SET(i->type, IMAGE_DIRECTORY, IMAGE_SUBVOLUME))
    3171                                  r = free_and_strdup(&arg_directory, i->path);
    3172                          else
    3173                                  assert_not_reached();
    3174                          if (r < 0)
    3175                                  return log_oom();
    3176                  } else {
    3177                          r = safe_getcwd(&arg_directory);
    3178                          if (r < 0)
    3179                                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to determine current directory: %m");
    3180                  }
    3181          }
    3182  
    3183          if (!arg_machine) {
    3184                  if (arg_directory && path_equal(arg_directory, "/")) {
    3185                          arg_machine = gethostname_malloc();
    3186                          if (!arg_machine)
    3187                                  return log_oom();
    3188                  } else if (arg_image) {
    3189                          char *e;
    3190  
    3191                          r = path_extract_filename(arg_image, &arg_machine);
    3192                          if (r < 0)
    3193                                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to extract file name from '%s': %m", arg_image);
    3194  
    3195                          /* Truncate suffix if there is one */
    3196                          e = endswith(arg_machine, ".raw");
    3197                          if (e)
    3198                                  *e = 0;
    3199                  } else {
    3200                          r = path_extract_filename(arg_directory, &arg_machine);

    3202                                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to extract file name from '%s': %m", arg_directory);

    3212                          return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL), "Failed to determine machine name automatically, please use -M.");
    3213          }
    3214  
    3215          return 0;
    3216  }

     841  static int open_vsock(void) {
     842          static const union sockaddr_union bind_addr = {
     843                  .vm.svm_family = AF_VSOCK,
     844                  .vm.svm_cid = VMADDR_CID_ANY,
     845                  .vm.svm_port = VMADDR_PORT_ANY,
     846          };
     847  
     848          _cleanup_close_ int vsock_fd = socket(AF_VSOCK, SOCK_STREAM|SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0);
     849          if (vsock_fd < 0)
     850                  return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to open AF_VSOCK socket: %m");
     851  
     852          if (bind(vsock_fd, &bind_addr.sa, sizeof(bind_addr.vm)) < 0)
     853                  return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to bind to VSOCK address %u:%u: %m", bind_addr.vm.svm_cid, bind_addr.vm.svm_port);
     854  
     855          if (listen(vsock_fd, SOMAXCONN_DELUXE) < 0)
     856                  return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to listen on VSOCK: %m");
     857  
     858          return TAKE_FD(vsock_fd);
     859  }
     860  
     861  typedef struct NotifyConnectionData {
     862          char buffer[NOTIFY_BUFFER_MAX+1];
     863          size_t full;
     864          int *exit_status;
     865  } NotifyConnectionData;
     866  
     867  static int read_vsock_notify(NotifyConnectionData *d, int fd) {
     868          int r;
     869  
     870          assert(d);
     871          assert(fd >= 0);
     872  
     873          for (;;) {
     874                  assert(d->full < sizeof(d->buffer));
     875  
     876                  ssize_t n = read(fd, d->buffer + d->full, sizeof(d->buffer) - d->full);
     877                  if (n < 0) {
     878                          if (ERRNO_IS_TRANSIENT(errno))
     879                                  return 0;
     880  
     881                          return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to read notification message: %m");
     882                  }
     883                  if (n == 0) /* We hit EOF! Let's parse this */
     884                          break;
     885  
     886                  if ((size_t) n >= sizeof(d->buffer) - d->full)
     887                          return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EBADMSG), "Received notify message exceeded maximum size.");
     888  
     889                  d->full += n;
     890          }
     891  
     892          /* We reached EOF, now parse the thing */
     893          assert(d->full < sizeof(d->buffer));
     894          d->buffer[d->full] = 0;
     895  
     896          _cleanup_strv_free_ char **tags = strv_split(d->buffer, "\n\r");
     897          if (!tags)
     898                  return log_oom();
     899  
     900          if (DEBUG_LOGGING) {
     901                  _cleanup_free_ char *j = strv_join(tags, " ");
     902                  log_debug("Received notification message with tags: %s", strnull(j));
     903          }
     904  
     905          const char *status = strv_find_startswith(tags, "STATUS=");
     906          if (status)
     907                  (void) sd_notifyf(/* unset_environment= */ false, "STATUS=VM running: %s", status);
     908  
     909          if (strv_contains(tags, "READY=1")) {
     910                  r = sd_notify(/* unset_environment= */ false, "READY=1");
     911                  if (r < 0)
     912                          log_warning_errno(r, "Failed to send readiness notification, ignoring: %m");
     913  
     914                  if (!status)
     915                          (void) sd_notifyf(/* unset_environment= */ false, "STATUS=VM running.");
     916          }
     917  
     918          const char *p = strv_find_startswith(tags, "EXIT_STATUS=");
     919          if (p) {
     920                  uint8_t k = 0;
     921                  r = safe_atou8(p, &k);
     922                  if (r < 0)
     923                          log_warning_errno(r, "Failed to parse exit status from %s, ignoring: %m", p);
     924                  else
     925                          *d->exit_status = k;
     926          }
     927  
     928          return 1; /* done */
     929  }
     930  
     931  static int vmspawn_dispatch_notify_fd(sd_event_source *source, int fd, uint32_t revents, void *userdata) {
     932          NotifyConnectionData *d = ASSERT_PTR(userdata);
     933          int r;
     934  
     935          assert(source);
     936          assert(fd >= 0);
     937  
     938          r = read_vsock_notify(d, fd);
     939          if (r != 0) {
     940                  int q;
     941  
     942                  /* If we are done or are seeing an error we'll turn off floating mode, which means the event
     943                   * loop itself won't keep the event source pinned anymore, and since no one else (hopefully!)
     944                   * keeps a reference anymore the whole thing will be released once we exit from this handler
     945                   * here. */
     946  
     947                  q = sd_event_source_set_floating(source, false);
     948                  if (q < 0)
     949                          log_warning_errno(q, "Failed to disable floating mode of event source, ignoring: %m");
     950  
     951                  return r;
     952          }
     953  
     954          return 0;
     955  }
     956  
     957  static int vmspawn_dispatch_vsock_connections(sd_event_source *source, int fd, uint32_t revents, void *userdata) {
     958          _cleanup_close_ int conn_fd = -EBADF;
     959          sd_event *event;
     960          int r;
     961  
     962          assert(userdata);
     963  
     964          if (revents != EPOLLIN) {
     965                  log_warning("Got unexpected poll event for VSOCK fd.");
     966                  return 0;
     967          }
     968  
     969          conn_fd = accept4(fd, NULL, NULL, SOCK_CLOEXEC|SOCK_NONBLOCK);
     970          if (conn_fd < 0) {
     971                  if (ERRNO_IS_TRANSIENT(errno))
     972                          return 0;
     973  
     974                  log_warning_errno(errno, "Failed to accept connection from VSOCK connection, ignoring: %m");
     975                  return 0;
     976          }
     977  
     978          event = sd_event_source_get_event(source);
     979          if (!event)
     980                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(ENOENT), "Failed to retrieve event from event source, exiting task");
     981  
     982          _cleanup_free_ NotifyConnectionData *d = new(NotifyConnectionData, 1);
     983          if (!d)
     984                  return log_oom();
     985  
     986          *d = (NotifyConnectionData) {
     987                  .exit_status = userdata,
     988          };
     989  
     990          /* add a new floating task to read from the connection */
     991          _cleanup_(sd_event_source_unrefp) sd_event_source *s = NULL;
     992          r = sd_event_add_io(event, &s, conn_fd, EPOLLIN, vmspawn_dispatch_notify_fd, d);
     993          if (r < 0)
     994                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to allocate notify connection event source: %m");
     995  
     996          r = sd_event_source_set_io_fd_own(s, true);
     997          if (r < 0)
     998                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to pass ownership of notify to event source: %m");
     999          TAKE_FD(conn_fd); /* conn_fd is now owned by the event loop so don't clean it up */
    1000  
    1001          r = sd_event_source_set_destroy_callback(s, free);
    1002          if (r < 0)
    1003                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to set destroy callback on event source: %m");
    1004          TAKE_PTR(d); /* The data object will now automatically be freed by the event source when it goes away */
    1005  
    1006          /* Finally, make sure the event loop pins the event source */
    1007          r = sd_event_source_set_floating(s, true);
    1008          if (r < 0)
    1009                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to set event source to floating mode: %m");
    1010  
    1011          (void) sd_event_source_set_description(s, "vmspawn-notify-socket-connection");
    1012  
    1013          return 0;
    1014  }
    1015  
    1016  static int setup_notify_parent(sd_event *event, int fd, int *exit_status, sd_event_source **ret_notify_event_source) {
    1017          int r;
    1018  
    1019          assert(event);
    1020          assert(fd >= 0);
    1021          assert(exit_status);
    1022          assert(ret_notify_event_source);
    1023  
    1024          r = sd_event_add_io(event, ret_notify_event_source, fd, EPOLLIN, vmspawn_dispatch_vsock_connections, exit_status);
    1025          if (r < 0)
    1026                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to allocate notify socket event source: %m");
    1027  
    1028          (void) sd_event_source_set_description(*ret_notify_event_source, "vmspawn-notify-socket-listen");
    1029  
    1030          return 0;
    1031  }
    1032  
    1033  static int bus_open_in_machine(sd_bus **ret, unsigned cid, unsigned port, const char *private_key_path) {
    1034          _cleanup_(sd_bus_flush_close_unrefp) sd_bus *bus = NULL;
    1035          _cleanup_free_ char *ssh_escaped = NULL, *bus_address = NULL;
    1036          char port_str[DECIMAL_STR_MAX(unsigned)], cid_str[DECIMAL_STR_MAX(unsigned)];
    1037          int r;
    1038  
    1039          assert(ret);
    1040          assert(private_key_path);
    1041  
    1042          r = sd_bus_new(&bus);
    1043          if (r < 0)
    1044                  return r;
    1045  
    1046          const char *ssh = secure_getenv("SYSTEMD_SSH") ?: "ssh";
    1047          ssh_escaped = bus_address_escape(ssh);
    1048          if (!ssh_escaped)
    1049                  return -ENOMEM;
    1050  
    1051          xsprintf(port_str, "%u", port);
    1052          xsprintf(cid_str, "%u", cid);
    1053  
    1054          bus_address = strjoin(
    1055                  "unixexec:path=", ssh_escaped,
    1056                  /* -x: Disable X11 forwarding
    1057                   * -T: Disable PTY allocation */
    1058                  ",argv1=-xT",
    1059                  ",argv2=-o,argv3=IdentitiesOnly yes",
    1060                  ",argv4=-o,argv5=IdentityFile=", private_key_path,
    1061                  ",argv6=-p,argv7=", port_str,
    1062                  ",argv8=--",
    1063                  ",argv9=root@vsock/", cid_str,
    1064                  ",argv10=systemd-stdio-bridge"
    1065          );
    1066          if (!bus_address)
    1067                  return -ENOMEM;
    1068  
    1069          free_and_replace(bus->address, bus_address);
    1070          bus->bus_client = true;
    1071          bus->trusted = true;
    1072          bus->runtime_scope = RUNTIME_SCOPE_SYSTEM;
    1073          bus->is_local = false;
    1074  
    1075          r = sd_bus_start(bus);
    1076          if (r < 0)
    1077                  return r;
    1078  
    1079          *ret = TAKE_PTR(bus);
    1080          return 0;
    1081  }
    1082  
    1083  static int shutdown_vm_graceful(sd_event_source *s, const struct signalfd_siginfo *si, void *userdata) {
    1084          _cleanup_(sd_bus_flush_close_unrefp) sd_bus *bus = NULL;
    1085          _cleanup_(sd_bus_error_free) sd_bus_error error = SD_BUS_ERROR_NULL;
    1086          ShutdownInfo *shutdown_info = ASSERT_PTR(userdata);
    1087          SSHInfo *ssh_info = ASSERT_PTR(shutdown_info->ssh_info);
    1088          int r;
    1089  
    1090          assert(s);
    1091          assert(si);
    1092  
    1093          /* If we don't have the vsock address and the SSH key, go to fallback */
    1094          if (ssh_info->cid == VMADDR_CID_ANY || !ssh_info->private_key_path)
    1095                  goto fallback;
    1096  
    1097          /*
    1098           * In order we should try:
    1099           * 1. PowerOff from logind respects inhibitors but might not be available
    1100           * 2. PowerOff from systemd heavy handed but should always be available
    1101           * 3. SIGKILL qemu (this waits for qemu to die still)
    1102           * 4. kill ourselves by shutting down our event loop (this does not wait for qemu)
    1103           */
    1104  
    1105          r = bus_open_in_machine(&bus, ssh_info->cid, ssh_info->port, ssh_info->private_key_path);
    1106          if (r < 0) {
    1107                  log_warning_errno(r, "Failed to connect to VM to forward signal, ignoring: %m");
    1108                  goto fallback;
    1109          }
    1110  
    1111          r = bus_call_method(bus, bus_login_mgr, "PowerOff", &error, /* ret_reply= */ NULL, "b", false);
    1112          if (r >= 0) {
    1113                  log_info("Requested powering off VM through D-Bus.");
    1114                  return 0;
    1115          }
    1116  
    1117          log_warning_errno(r, "Failed to shutdown VM via logind, ignoring: %s", bus_error_message(&error, r));
    1118          sd_bus_error_free(&error);
    1119  
    1120          r = bus_call_method(bus, bus_systemd_mgr, "PowerOff", &error, /* ret_reply= */ NULL, /* types= */ NULL);
    1121          if (r >= 0) {
    1122                  log_info("Requested powering off VM through D-Bus.");
    1123                  return 0;
    1124          }
    1125  
    1126          log_warning_errno(r, "Failed to shutdown VM via systemd, ignoring: %s", bus_error_message(&error, r));
    1127  
    1128  fallback:
    1129          /* at this point SSH clearly isn't working so don't try it again */
    1130          TAKE_STRUCT(*ssh_info);
    1131  
    1132          /* Backup method to shut down the VM when D-BUS access over SSH is not available */
    1133          if (shutdown_info->pidref) {
    1134                  r = pidref_kill(shutdown_info->pidref, SIGKILL);
    1135                  if (r < 0)
    1136                          log_warning_errno(r, "Failed to kill qemu, terminating: %m");
    1137                  else {
    1138                          TAKE_PTR(shutdown_info->pidref);
    1139                          log_info("Trying to halt qemu. Send SIGTERM again to trigger vmspawn to immediately terminate.");
    1140                          return 0;
    1141                  }
    1142          }
    1143  
    1144          return sd_event_exit(sd_event_source_get_event(s), 0);
    1145  }
    1146  
    1147  static int on_child_exit(sd_event_source *s, const siginfo_t *si, void *userdata) {
    1148          assert(si);
    1149  
    1150          /* Let's first do some logging about the exit status of the child. */
    1151  
    1152          int ret;
    1153          if (si->si_code == CLD_EXITED) {
    1154                  if (si->si_status == EXIT_SUCCESS)
    1155                          log_debug("Child process " PID_FMT " exited successfully.", si->si_pid);
    1156                  else
    1157                          log_error("Child process " PID_FMT " died with a failure exit status %i.", si->si_pid, si->si_status);
    1158  
    1159                  ret = si->si_status;
    1160          } else if (si->si_code == CLD_KILLED)
    1161                  ret = log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EPROTO),
    1162                                        "Child process " PID_FMT " was killed by signal %s.",
    1163                                        si->si_pid, signal_to_string(si->si_status));
    1164          else if (si->si_code == CLD_DUMPED)
    1165                  ret = log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EPROTO),
    1166                                        "Child process " PID_FMT " dumped core by signal %s.",
    1167                                        si->si_pid, signal_to_string(si->si_status));
    1168          else
    1169                  ret = log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EPROTO),
    1170                                        "Got unexpected exit code %i from child.",
    1171                                        si->si_code);
    1172  
    1173          /* Regardless of whether the main qemu process or an auxiliary process died, let's exit either way
    1174           * as it's very likely that the main qemu process won't be able to operate properly anymore if one
    1175           * of the auxiliary processes died. */
    1176  
    1177          sd_event_exit(sd_event_source_get_event(s), ret);
    1178          return 0;
    1179  }

    1181  static int cmdline_add_vsock(char ***cmdline, int vsock_fd) {
    1182          int r;
    1183  
    1184          r = strv_extend(cmdline, "-smbios");
    1185          if (r < 0)
    1186                  return r;
    1187  
    1188          union sockaddr_union addr;
    1189          socklen_t addr_len = sizeof addr.vm;
    1190          if (getsockname(vsock_fd, &addr.sa, &addr_len) < 0)
    1191                  return -errno;
    1192  
    1193          assert(addr_len >= sizeof addr.vm);
    1194          assert(addr.vm.svm_family == AF_VSOCK);
    1195  
    1196          r = strv_extendf(cmdline, "type=11,value=io.systemd.credential:vmm.notify_socket=vsock-stream:%u:%u", (unsigned) VMADDR_CID_HOST, addr.vm.svm_port);
    1197          if (r < 0)
    1198                  return r;
    1199  
    1200          return 0;
    1201  }

    1204          int r;

    1211          _cleanup_free_ char *kcl = strv_join(arg_kernel_cmdline_extra, " ");

    1213                  return log_oom();
    1214  
    1215          if (kernel) {
    1216                  if (strv_extend_many(cmdline, "-append", kcl) < 0)

    1218          } else {
    1219                  if (!ARCHITECTURE_SUPPORTS_SMBIOS) {
    1220                          log_warning("Cannot append extra args to kernel cmdline, native architecture doesn't support SMBIOS, ignoring.");
    1221                          return 0;
    1222                  }
    1223  
    1224                  FOREACH_STRING(id, "io.systemd.stub.kernel-cmdline-extra", "io.systemd.boot.kernel-cmdline-extra") {
    1225                          _cleanup_free_ char *p = path_join(smbios_dir, id);

    1227                                  return log_oom();
    1228  
    1229                          r = write_string_filef(
    1230                                          p,
    1231                                          WRITE_STRING_FILE_CREATE|WRITE_STRING_FILE_AVOID_NEWLINE|WRITE_STRING_FILE_MODE_0600,
    1232                                          "%s=%s", id, kcl);
    1233                          if (r < 0)
    1234                                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to write smbios kernel command line to file: %m");
    1235  
    1236                          if (strv_extend(cmdline, "-smbios") < 0)
    1237                                  return log_oom();
    1238  
    1239                          if (strv_extend_joined(cmdline, "type=11,path=", p) < 0)
    1240                                  return log_oom();
    1241                  }
    1242          }
    1243  
    1244          return 0;
    1245  }

    1247  static int cmdline_add_smbios11(char ***cmdline, const char* smbios_dir) {

    1285  static int start_tpm(
    1286                  const char *scope,
    1287                  const char *swtpm,
    1288                  const char *runtime_dir,
    1289                  const char *sd_socket_activate,
    1290                  char **ret_listen_address,
    1291                  PidRef *ret_pidref) {
    1292  
    1293          int r;
    1294  
    1295          assert(scope);
    1296          assert(swtpm);
    1297          assert(runtime_dir);
    1298  
    1299          _cleanup_free_ char *scope_prefix = NULL;
    1300          r = unit_name_to_prefix(scope, &scope_prefix);
    1301          if (r < 0)
    1302                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to strip .scope suffix from scope: %m");
    1303  
    1304          _cleanup_free_ char *listen_address = path_join(runtime_dir, "tpm.sock");
    1305          if (!listen_address)
    1306                  return log_oom();
    1307  
    1308          _cleanup_free_ char *transient_state_dir = NULL;
    1309          const char *state_dir;
    1310          if (arg_tpm_state_path)
    1311                  state_dir = arg_tpm_state_path;
    1312          else {
    1313                  _cleanup_free_ char *dirname = strjoin(scope_prefix, "-tpm");
    1314                  if (!dirname)
    1315                          return log_oom();
    1316  
    1317                  transient_state_dir = path_join(runtime_dir, dirname);
    1318                  if (!transient_state_dir)
    1319                          return log_oom();
    1320  
    1321                  state_dir = transient_state_dir;
    1322          }
    1323  
    1324          r = mkdir_p(state_dir, 0700);
    1325          if (r < 0)
    1326                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to create TPM state directory '%s': %m", state_dir);
    1327  
    1328          _cleanup_free_ char *swtpm_setup = NULL;
    1329          r = find_executable("swtpm_setup", &swtpm_setup);
    1330          if (r < 0)
    1331                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to find swtpm_setup binary: %m");
    1332  
    1333          /* Try passing --profile-name default-v2 first, in order to support RSA4096 pcrsig keys, which was
    1334           * added in 0.11. */
    1335          _cleanup_strv_free_ char **argv = strv_new(
    1336                          swtpm_setup,
    1337                          "--tpm-state", state_dir,
    1338                          "--tpm2",
    1339                          "--pcr-banks", "sha256",
    1340                          "--not-overwrite",
    1341                          "--profile-name", "default-v2");
    1342          if (!argv)
    1343                  return log_oom();
    1344  
    1345          r = pidref_safe_fork("(swtpm-setup)", FORK_CLOSE_ALL_FDS|FORK_LOG|FORK_WAIT, /* ret= */ NULL);
    1346          if (r == 0) {
    1347                  /* Child */
    1348                  execvp(argv[0], argv);
    1349                  log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to execute '%s': %m", argv[0]);
    1350                  _exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    1351          }
    1352          if (r == -EPROTO) {
    1353                  /* If swtpm_setup fails, try again removing the default-v2 profile, as it might be an older
    1354                   * version. */
    1355                  strv_remove(argv, "--profile-name");
    1356                  strv_remove(argv, "default-v2");
    1357  
    1358                  r = pidref_safe_fork("(swtpm-setup)", FORK_CLOSE_ALL_FDS|FORK_LOG|FORK_WAIT, /* ret= */ NULL);
    1359                  if (r == 0) {
    1360                          /* Child */
    1361                          execvp(argv[0], argv);
    1362                          log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to execute '%s': %m", argv[0]);
    1363                          _exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    1364                  }
    1365          }
    1366          if (r < 0)
    1367                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to run swtpm_setup: %m");
    1368  
    1369          strv_free(argv);
    1370          argv = strv_new(sd_socket_activate, "--listen", listen_address, swtpm, "socket", "--tpm2", "--tpmstate");
    1371          if (!argv)
    1372                  return log_oom();
    1373  
    1374          r = strv_extend_joined(&argv, "dir=", state_dir);
    1375          if (r < 0)
    1376                  return log_oom();
    1377  
    1378          r = strv_extend_many(&argv, "--ctrl", "type=unixio,fd=3");
    1379          if (r < 0)
    1380                  return log_oom();
    1381  
    1382          r = fork_notify(argv, ret_pidref);
    1383          if (r < 0)
    1384                  return r;
    1385  
    1386          if (ret_listen_address)
    1387                  *ret_listen_address = TAKE_PTR(listen_address);
    1388  
    1389          return 0;
    1390  }

    1443  static int discover_root(char **ret) {
    1444          int r;
    1445          _cleanup_(dissected_image_unrefp) DissectedImage *image = NULL;

    1462                  root = strjoin("root=PARTUUID=", SD_ID128_TO_UUID_STRING(image->partitions[PARTITION_ROOT].uuid));
    1463          else if (image->partitions[PARTITION_USR].found)

    1465          else

    1475  static int find_virtiofsd(char **ret) {
    1476          int r;
    1477          _cleanup_free_ char *virtiofsd = NULL;
    1478  
    1479          assert(ret);
    1480  
    1481          r = find_executable("virtiofsd", &virtiofsd);
    1482          if (r < 0 && r != -ENOENT)
    1483                  return log_error_errno(r, "Error while searching for virtiofsd: %m");
    1484  
    1485          if (!virtiofsd) {
    1486                  FOREACH_STRING(file, "/usr/libexec/virtiofsd", "/usr/lib/virtiofsd") {
    1487                          if (access(file, X_OK) >= 0) {
    1488                                  virtiofsd = strdup(file);
    1489                                  if (!virtiofsd)
    1490                                          return log_oom();
    1491                                  break;
    1492                          }
    1493  
    1494                          if (!IN_SET(errno, ENOENT, EACCES))
    1495                                  return log_error_errno(errno, "Error while searching for virtiofsd: %m");
    1496                  }
    1497          }
    1498  
    1499          if (!virtiofsd)
    1500                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(ENOENT), "Failed to find virtiofsd binary.");
    1501  
    1502          *ret = TAKE_PTR(virtiofsd);
    1503          return 0;
    1504  }
    1505  
    1506  static int start_virtiofsd(
    1507                  const char *scope,
    1508                  const char *directory,
    1509                  uid_t source_uid,
    1510                  uid_t target_uid,
    1511                  uid_t uid_range,
    1512                  const char *runtime_dir,
    1513                  char **ret_listen_address,
    1514                  PidRef *ret_pidref) {
    1515  
    1516          int r;
    1517  
    1518          assert(scope);
    1519          assert(directory);
    1520          assert(runtime_dir);
    1521  
    1522          _cleanup_free_ char *virtiofsd = NULL;
    1523          r = find_virtiofsd(&virtiofsd);
    1524          if (r < 0)
    1525                  return r;
    1526  
    1527          _cleanup_free_ char *scope_prefix = NULL;
    1528          r = unit_name_to_prefix(scope, &scope_prefix);
    1529          if (r < 0)
    1530                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to strip .scope suffix from scope: %m");
    1531  
    1532          _cleanup_free_ char *listen_address = NULL;
    1533          if (asprintf(&listen_address, "%s/sock-%"PRIx64, runtime_dir, random_u64()) < 0)
    1534                  return log_oom();
    1535  
    1536          union sockaddr_union su;
    1537          r = sockaddr_un_set_path(&su.un, listen_address);
    1538          if (r < 0)
    1539                  return r;
    1540  
    1541          _cleanup_close_ int sock = socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM|SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0);
    1542          if (sock < 0)
    1543                  return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to create unix socket: %m");
    1544  
    1545          if (bind(sock, &su.sa, r) < 0)
    1546                  return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to bind unix socket to '%s': %m", listen_address);
    1547  
    1548          if (listen(sock, SOMAXCONN_DELUXE) < 0)
    1549                  return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to listen on unix socket '%s': %m", listen_address);
    1550  
    1551          _cleanup_free_ char *sockstr = NULL;
    1552          if (asprintf(&sockstr, "%i", sock) < 0)
    1553                  return log_oom();
    1554  
    1555          /* QEMU doesn't support submounts so don't announce them */
    1556          _cleanup_strv_free_ char **argv = strv_new(
    1557                          virtiofsd,
    1558                          "--shared-dir", source_uid == FOREIGN_UID_MIN ? "/run/systemd/mount-rootfs" : directory,
    1559                          "--xattr",
    1560                          "--fd", sockstr,
    1561                          "--sandbox=chroot",
    1562                          "--no-announce-submounts");
    1563          if (!argv)
    1564                  return log_oom();
    1565  
    1566          _cleanup_close_ int userns_fd = -EBADF, mapped_fd = -EBADF;
    1567  
    1568          if (source_uid == FOREIGN_UID_MIN) {
    1569                  assert(target_uid == 0);
    1570                  assert(uid_range == 0x10000);
    1571  
    1572                  userns_fd = nsresource_allocate_userns(/* vl= */ NULL, /* name= */ NULL, NSRESOURCE_UIDS_64K);
    1573                  if (userns_fd < 0)
    1574                          return log_error_errno(userns_fd, "Failed to allocate user namespace for virtiofsd: %m");
    1575  
    1576                  _cleanup_close_ int directory_fd = open(directory, O_DIRECTORY|O_CLOEXEC|O_PATH);
    1577                  if (directory_fd < 0)
    1578                          return log_error_errno(directory_fd, "Failed to open '%s': %m", directory);
    1579  
    1580                  r = mountfsd_mount_directory_fd(/* vl= */ NULL, directory_fd, userns_fd, DISSECT_IMAGE_FOREIGN_UID, &mapped_fd);
    1581                  if (r < 0)
    1582                          return r;
    1583  
    1584          } else if (!IN_SET(source_uid, FOREIGN_UID_MIN, UID_INVALID) && target_uid != UID_INVALID && uid_range != UID_INVALID) {
    1585                  r = strv_extend(&argv, "--translate-uid");
    1586                  if (r < 0)
    1587                          return log_oom();
    1588  
    1589                  r = strv_extendf(&argv, "map:" UID_FMT ":" UID_FMT ":" UID_FMT, target_uid, source_uid, uid_range);
    1590                  if (r < 0)
    1591                          return log_oom();
    1592  
    1593                  r = strv_extend(&argv, "--translate-gid");
    1594                  if (r < 0)
    1595                          return log_oom();
    1596  
    1597                  r = strv_extendf(&argv, "map:" GID_FMT ":" GID_FMT ":" GID_FMT, target_uid, source_uid, uid_range);
    1598                  if (r < 0)
    1599                          return log_oom();
    1600          }
    1601  
    1602          r = pidref_safe_fork_full(
    1603                          "(virtiofsd)",
    1604                          (const int[3]) { -EBADF, STDOUT_FILENO, STDERR_FILENO },
    1605                          (int[]) { sock, userns_fd, mapped_fd },
    1606                          source_uid == FOREIGN_UID_MIN ? 3 : 1,
    1607                          FORK_RESET_SIGNALS|FORK_DEATHSIG_SIGTERM|FORK_CLOSE_ALL_FDS|FORK_REOPEN_LOG|FORK_REARRANGE_STDIO,
    1608                          ret_pidref);
    1609          if (r < 0)
    1610                  return r;
    1611          if (r == 0) {
    1612                  /* Child */
    1613  
    1614                  r = namespace_enter(
    1615                                  /* pidns_fd= */ -EBADF,
    1616                                  /* mntns_fd= */ -EBADF,
    1617                                  /* netns_fd= */ -EBADF,
    1618                                  userns_fd,
    1619                                  /* root_fd= */ -EBADF);
    1620                  if (r < 0) {
    1621                          log_error_errno(r, "Failed to enter user namespace for virtiofsd: %m");
    1622                          _exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    1623                  }
    1624  
    1625                  if (userns_fd >= 0 && unshare(CLONE_NEWNS) < 0) {
    1626                          log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to unshare mount namespace %m");
    1627                          _exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    1628                  }
    1629  
    1630                  if (mapped_fd >= 0 && move_mount(mapped_fd, "", AT_FDCWD, "/run/systemd/mount-rootfs", MOVE_MOUNT_F_EMPTY_PATH) < 0) {
    1631                          log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to move mount file descriptor to '/run/systemd/mount-rootfs': %m");
    1632                          _exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    1633                  }
    1634  
    1635                  r = fd_cloexec(sock, false);
    1636                  if (r < 0) {
    1637                          log_error_errno(r, "Failed to disable cloexec on socket: %m");
    1638                          _exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    1639                  }
    1640  
    1641                  invoke_callout_binary(argv[0], argv);
    1642                  log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to execute '%s': %m", argv[0]);
    1643                  _exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    1644          }
    1645  
    1646          if (ret_listen_address)
    1647                  *ret_listen_address = TAKE_PTR(listen_address);
    1648  
    1649          return 0;
    1650  }

    1692  
    1693                  _cleanup_(runtime_mount_done) RuntimeMount mount = {

    1733  static int discover_boot_entry(const char *root, char **ret_linux, char ***ret_initrds) {
    1734          _cleanup_(boot_config_free) BootConfig config = BOOT_CONFIG_NULL;
    1735          _cleanup_free_ char *esp_path = NULL, *xbootldr_path = NULL;
    1736          int r;
    1737  
    1738          assert(root);
    1739          assert(ret_linux);
    1740          assert(ret_initrds);
    1741  
    1742          esp_path = path_join(root, "efi");
    1743          if (!esp_path)
    1744                  return log_oom();
    1745  
    1746          xbootldr_path = path_join(root, "boot");
    1747          if (!xbootldr_path)
    1748                  return log_oom();
    1749  
    1750          r = boot_config_load(&config, esp_path, xbootldr_path);
    1751          if (r < 0)
    1752                  return r;
    1753  
    1754          r = boot_config_select_special_entries(&config, /* skip_efivars= */ true);
    1755          if (r < 0)
    1756                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to find special boot config entries: %m");
    1757  
    1758          const BootEntry *boot_entry = boot_config_default_entry(&config);
    1759  
    1760          if (boot_entry && !IN_SET(boot_entry->type, BOOT_ENTRY_TYPE1, BOOT_ENTRY_TYPE2))
    1761                  boot_entry = NULL;
    1762  
    1763          /* If we cannot determine a default entry search for UKIs (Type #2 EFI Unified Kernel Images)
    1764           * then .conf files (Type #1 Boot Loader Specification Entries).
    1765           * https://uapi-group.org/specifications/specs/boot_loader_specification */
    1766          if (!boot_entry)
    1767                  FOREACH_ARRAY(entry, config.entries, config.n_entries)
    1768                          if (entry->type == BOOT_ENTRY_TYPE2) { /* UKI */
    1769                                  boot_entry = entry;
    1770                                  break;
    1771                          }
    1772  
    1773          if (!boot_entry)
    1774                  FOREACH_ARRAY(entry, config.entries, config.n_entries)
    1775                          if (entry->type == BOOT_ENTRY_TYPE1) { /* .conf */
    1776                                  boot_entry = entry;
    1777                                  break;
    1778                          }
    1779  
    1780          if (!boot_entry)
    1781                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(ENOENT), "Failed to discover any boot entries.");
    1782  
    1783          log_debug("Discovered boot entry %s (%s)", boot_entry->id, boot_entry_type_description_to_string(boot_entry->type));
    1784  
    1785          _cleanup_free_ char *linux_kernel = NULL;
    1786          _cleanup_strv_free_ char **initrds = NULL;
    1787          if (boot_entry->type == BOOT_ENTRY_TYPE2) { /* UKI */
    1788                  linux_kernel = path_join(boot_entry->root, boot_entry->kernel);
    1789                  if (!linux_kernel)
    1790                          return log_oom();
    1791          } else if (boot_entry->type == BOOT_ENTRY_TYPE1) { /* .conf */
    1792                  linux_kernel = path_join(boot_entry->root, boot_entry->kernel);
    1793                  if (!linux_kernel)
    1794                          return log_oom();
    1795  
    1796                  STRV_FOREACH(initrd, boot_entry->initrd) {
    1797                          _cleanup_free_ char *initrd_path = path_join(boot_entry->root, *initrd);
    1798                          if (!initrd_path)
    1799                                  return log_oom();
    1800  
    1801                          r = strv_consume(&initrds, TAKE_PTR(initrd_path));
    1802                          if (r < 0)
    1803                                  return log_oom();
    1804                  }
    1805          } else
    1806                  assert_not_reached();
    1807  
    1808          *ret_linux = TAKE_PTR(linux_kernel);
    1809          *ret_initrds = TAKE_PTR(initrds);
    1810  
    1811          return 0;
    1812  }
    1813  
    1814  static int merge_initrds(char **ret) {
    1815          _cleanup_(rm_rf_physical_and_freep) char *merged_initrd = NULL;
    1816          _cleanup_close_ int ofd = -EBADF;
    1817          int r;
    1818  
    1819          assert(ret);
    1820  
    1821          r = tempfn_random_child(NULL, "vmspawn-initrd-", &merged_initrd);
    1822          if (r < 0)
    1823                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to create temporary file: %m");
    1824  
    1825          ofd = open(merged_initrd, O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_CLOEXEC, 0600);
    1826          if (ofd < 0)
    1827                  return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to create regular file %s: %m", merged_initrd);
    1828  
    1829          STRV_FOREACH(i, arg_initrds) {
    1830                  _cleanup_close_ int ifd = -EBADF;
    1831                  off_t off, to_seek;
    1832  
    1833                  off = lseek(ofd, 0, SEEK_CUR);
    1834                  if (off < 0)
    1835                          return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to get file offset of %s: %m", merged_initrd);
    1836  
    1837                  to_seek = (4 - (off % 4)) % 4;
    1838  
    1839                  /* seek to assure 4 byte alignment for each initrd */
    1840                  if (to_seek != 0 && lseek(ofd, to_seek, SEEK_CUR) < 0)
    1841                          return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to seek %s: %m", merged_initrd);
    1842  
    1843                  ifd = open(*i, O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC);
    1844                  if (ifd < 0)
    1845                          return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to open %s: %m", *i);
    1846  
    1847                  r = copy_bytes(ifd, ofd, UINT64_MAX, COPY_REFLINK);
    1848                  if (r < 0)
    1849                          return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to copy bytes from %s to %s: %m", *i, merged_initrd);
    1850          }
    1851  
    1852          *ret = TAKE_PTR(merged_initrd);
    1853          return 0;
    1854  }

    1856  static int generate_ssh_keypair(const char *key_path, const char *key_type) {
    1857          _cleanup_free_ char *ssh_keygen = NULL;
    1858          _cleanup_strv_free_ char **cmdline = NULL;
    1859          int r;
    1860  
    1861          assert(key_path);
    1862  
    1863          r = find_executable("ssh-keygen", &ssh_keygen);
    1864          if (r < 0)
    1865                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to find ssh-keygen: %m");
    1866  
    1867          cmdline = strv_new(ssh_keygen, "-f", key_path, /* don't encrypt the key */ "-N", "");
    1868          if (!cmdline)
    1869                  return log_oom();
    1870  
    1871          if (key_type) {
    1872                  r = strv_extend_many(&cmdline, "-t", key_type);
    1873                  if (r < 0)
    1874                          return log_oom();
    1875          }
    1876  
    1877          if (DEBUG_LOGGING) {
    1878                  _cleanup_free_ char *joined = quote_command_line(cmdline, SHELL_ESCAPE_EMPTY);
    1879                  if (!joined)
    1880                          return log_oom();
    1881  
    1882                  log_debug("Executing: %s", joined);
    1883          }
    1884  
    1885          r = pidref_safe_fork_full(
    1886                          ssh_keygen,
    1887                          (int[]) { -EBADF, -EBADF, STDERR_FILENO },
    1888                          /* except_fds= */ NULL, /* n_except_fds= */ 0,
    1889                          FORK_WAIT|FORK_RESET_SIGNALS|FORK_CLOSE_ALL_FDS|FORK_DEATHSIG_SIGTERM|FORK_LOG|FORK_RLIMIT_NOFILE_SAFE|FORK_REARRANGE_STDIO|FORK_REOPEN_LOG,
    1890                          /* ret= */ NULL);
    1891          if (r < 0)
    1892                  return r;
    1893          if (r == 0) {
    1894                  execv(ssh_keygen, cmdline);
    1895                  log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to execve %s: %m", ssh_keygen);
    1896                  _exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    1897          }
    1898  
    1899          return 0;
    1900  }
    1901  
    1902  static int grow_image(const char *path, uint64_t size) {
    1903          int r;
    1904  
    1905          assert(path);
    1906  
    1907          if (size == 0)
    1908                  return 0;
    1909  
    1910          /* Round up to multiple of 4K */
    1911          size = DIV_ROUND_UP(size, 4096);
    1912          if (size > UINT64_MAX / 4096)
    1913                  return log_error_errno(SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL), "Specified file size too large, refusing.");
    1914          size *= 4096;
    1915  
    1916          _cleanup_close_ int fd = xopenat_full(AT_FDCWD, path, O_RDWR|O_CLOEXEC, XO_REGULAR, /* mode= */ 0);
    1917          if (fd < 0)
    1918                  return log_error_errno(fd, "Failed to open image file '%s': %m", path);
    1919  
    1920          struct stat st;
    1921          if (fstat(fd, &st) < 0)
    1922                  return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to stat '%s': %m", path);
    1923          if ((uint64_t) st.st_size >= size) {
    1924                  log_debug("Not growing image '%s' to %s, size already at %s.", path,
    1925                            FORMAT_BYTES(size), FORMAT_BYTES(st.st_size));
    1926                  return 0;
    1927          }
    1928  
    1929          if (ftruncate(fd, size) < 0)
    1930                  return log_error_errno(errno, "Failed to grow image file '%s' from %s to %s: %m", path,
    1931                                         FORMAT_BYTES(st.st_size), FORMAT_BYTES(size));
    1932  
    1933          r = fsync_full(fd);
    1934          if (r < 0)
    1935                  return log_error_errno(r, "Failed to sync image file '%s' after growing to %s: %m", path, FORMAT_BYTES(size));
    1936  
    1937          if (!arg_quiet)
    1938                  log_info("Image file '%s' successfully grown from %s to %s.", path, FORMAT_BYTES(st.st_size), FORMAT_BYTES(size));
    1939  
    1940          return 1;
    1941  }

    2022

    2025  
    2026          _cleanup_(machine_bind_user_context_freep) MachineBindUserContext *bind_user_context = NULL;
    2027          r = machine_bind_user_prepare(

    2044          const char *hpet = ARCHITECTURE_SUPPORTS_HPET ? ",hpet=off" : "";
